verses.text: U Solomon khun u Dabid u la pynkhlaiñ ïa lade ha ka hima, namarba u Trai u Blei jong u U la don ryngkat bad u, bad U la pynlong ïa u u bakhraw shikatdei eh.
Te u Solomon u la kren ha ki Israel baroh, ha ki rangbah pyrton jong ki shihajar bad ki shispah, ha ki nongïalam Israel baroh, bad ha ki rangbah ïing kur.
U Solomon u la leit bad u paidbah paidlang baroh sha u lum ha Gibeon, namar ka ïingjaiñ jingïakynduh jong u Blei, kaba u Moses u shakri u Trai u la thaw ha ri kynjah, ka la don hangta.
(Hynrei u Dabid u la lah wan rah ïa ka synduk jutang u Blei na Kiriath-Jearim sha ka jaka ba u la pynkhreh na ka bynta jong ka, namar u la pynïeng kawei ka ïingjaiñ na ka bynta jong ka ha Jerusalem.)
Ka duwan rnong kaba u Besalel u khun u Uri u khun u Hur u la thaw, ka la don hangta hakhmat ka tabernakyl u Trai. U Solomon bad kata ka jingïalang baroh kawei ki la wad jingtip na u Trai hangta.
Te u Solomon u la leit kiew sha kata ka duwan kaba don ha kata ka ïingjaiñ jingïakynduh bad u la tyrwa hakhmat u Trai shihajar tylli ki jynkñia thang halor jong ka.
Ha kata ka miet u Blei U la paw ha u Solomon, bad U la ong ha u, “To pan na Nga ïa kata kaba phi kwah ba Ngan ai ïa phi.”
U Solomon u la ong ha u Blei, “Phi la pynpaw ka jingieid sbun ka bakhraw bad baskhem ïa u Dabid u kpa jong nga, bad Me la pynlong syiem ïa nga ban mih bteng ïa u.
A Trai ko Blei, ai ba yn pyndep mynta ïa ka jingkular jong Me ha u Dabid u kpa jong nga, namar Me la pynlong syiem ïa nga halor u paid u babun kat u shyiap ka khyndew.
To ai ïa nga mynta ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang ban leit ban wan hakhmat une u paid, naba mano keiñ uba lah ban synshar ïa une u paid jong Me uba khraw katta katta?”

U Blei U la jubab ïa u Solomon, “Namarba kane ka long ka jingkwah jong phi, bad phim shym la pan ban ïoh ka khyndew ka shyiap ne ka spah ne burom ne ïa ka jingim jong kito kiba shun ïa phi, ne wat ïa ka jingim ka bajlan, hynrei phi la pan ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang ïa lade ba phin dup lah ban synshar ïa ki briew jong Nga kiba Nga la aiti ha phi haba Nga thung syiem ïa phi,
Nga ai ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang. Ngan ai ruh ïa phi ka spah, ka ïoh ka kot bad ka burom, kaba ki syiem ha shuwa jong phi kim pat ju ïoh bad kaba kiba hadien habud ruh kin ym ïoh.”
U Solomon u la wan phai sha Jerusalem na ka duwan halor lum kaba ha Gibeon bad u la long syiem halor ki Israel.
Te u Solomon u la lum lang ïa ki kali bad ki nongshong kulai bad u la don khatsawspah ki kali bad khat-ar hajar ki nongshong kulai. U la buh ïa kine ha ki shnong kali, bad ka Jerusalem bad u syiem.
U syiem u la pynlong ba ka rupa bad ka ksiar ha Jerusalem kin kynrei kum ki maw, bad u la pynlong ba u dieng kedar un pahuh kum u dieng dymbur ka Shephela.
U Solomon u la wan lam ruh ki kulai na Ijipt bad Kue, ki nongkhaïi u syiem pat ki la ïoh ïa ki na Kue da kaba shu thied.

Ki la thied ïa ki kali na Ijipt ha ka dor hynriew spah shekel rupa kawei, bad ïa ki kulai shispah sanphew shekel uwei. Ha kajuh ka rukom kine ki briew ki la shalan ïa kine sha ki syiem Hit bad syiem Siria baroh.
U Solomon u la rai ban tei ka tempyl na ka bynta ka kyrteng u Trai bad ka ïing dulan syiem na ka bynta ïa lade.
Kumta u Solomon u la buh hynñiewphew hajar ngut ki briew ban kit jingkit, bad phraphew hajar ngut ban tih maw na ki par ha ri lum, sa laihajar hynriewspah ngut pat ban peit ïa ki.
Nangta u Solomon u la phah ktien sha u Huram syiem Tirus, “Kumba phi la leh bad u Dabid u kpa jong nga haba phi la phah ïa u ki dieng kedar ba un tei ïa la ka ïing dulan to leh ruh bad nga.

Nga mut ban tei ka ïing na ka bynta ka kyrteng u Trai u Blei jong nga bad ban aiti kyntang ïa ka ha U, ban thang ïa ka dhup iwbih hakhmat jong U, ban tyrwa khlem da pud ïa u ’pu-pyni bad ban tyrwa jynkñia thang mynstep bad janmiet, ha ki sngi sabath ha ki ’nai-thymmai bad ha ki niam ki rukom kiba kyrpang jong u Trai u Blei jong ngi, namar kane ka long ka hukum kaba shi junom ïa ki Israel.
Ka ïing kaba nga dei ban tei kan long ka bakhraw, namar u Blei jong ngi U long u ba kham khraw ban ïa ki blei baroh.

Hynrei mano keiñ ba lah ban tei ka ïing na ka bynta jong U, haba ka bneng, wat ka bneng, kaba ha khlieh tam, kam lah ban ngiam ïa U? Uei keiñ ma nga ban tei ka ïing na ka bynta jong U, lait kum ka jaka ban thang jyniwbih hakhmat jong U?

Kumta phah sha nga uwei u briew u bastad ban trei ïa ka ksiar, ka rupa, ka rnong bad u nar, ïa ki jaiñ sawbthuh, jaiñ saw-syngiang bad jaiñ jngum, bad uba nang ruh ïa ka kam pruid dur. Un ïatrei lang bad ki stad jong nga kiba don ha Juda bad Jerusalem, kiba u Dabid u kpa jong nga u la lah taïar lypa.

Phah ruh ïa nga ki dieng kedar ki dieng kseh bad ki dieng alkum na Lebanon, namar nga tip ba ki nongtrei jong phi ki nang ïa ka rukom pom dieng ha Lebanon. Ki nongtrei jong nga ruh kin ïatrei lang bad ki nongtrei jong phi,
ban pynkhreh shikat dei ka dieng, namar ka ïing ba ngan tei kan long ka bakhraw bad ka baphylla.
Ïa ki nongpom dieng jong phi kiba dei ban khet ïa ki dieng, ngan ai arphew hajar busta u kew dung, arphew hajar busta u barli, arphew hajar khra ka waiñ, bad arphew hajar khra ka umphniang.”
Te u Huram syiem Tirus u la jubab da ka shithi ba u phah sha u Solomon, “Namarba u Trai U ieid ïa la ki briew, U la thung syiem ïa phi halor jong ki.”

U Huram u la ong ruh, “Long ba la kyrkhu u Trai u Blei ki Israel, Uba la thaw ïa ka bneng bad ka khyndew, Uba la ai ïa u syiem Dabid u khun u bastad, uba la pura ka jingsian bad ka jingshemphang, uban sa tei ka tempyl na ka bynta u Trai, bad ka ïing dulan syiem na ka bynta ïa lade.
“Nga la phah mynta uwei u briew u bastad, uba la pura ka jingshemphang, u Huram-Abi,

u khun kawei ka briew kaba na ki khun kynthei u Dan, bad u kpa jong u u dei u nong Tirus. U la ïoh jinghikai ban trei ïa ka ksiar, ka rupa, ka rnong, u nar, u maw bad ka dieng, ïa ki jaiñ sawbthuh, jaiñ jngum, jaiñ sawsyngiang bad jaiñ linen bani, bad ban trei ki jait kam pruid dak baroh bad ban pyndep ïa kano kano ka jingsaiñdur ba phah leh ha u, lem bad ki stad nongtrei jong phi, ki jong u kynrad jong nga, u Dabid u kpa jong phi.
Namarkata to u kynrad jong nga un phah sha ki shakri jong u ïa u kew bad u barli, ïa ka waiñ bad ka umphniang, kiba u la kular.
Ngin pom ïa ki dieng katba phi donkam na Lebanon, bad ngin pynpoi ïa ki na duriaw da ki bur haduh Joppa, nangta phi pat phin kit ïa ki shaduh Jerusalem.”

Te u Solomon u la shim jingkheiñ ïa ki mynder baroh kiba la don ha ri Israel, katkum ka jingkheiñ ba u Dabid u kpa jong u u la shim ïa ki. La shem ba ki don shispah sanphew lai hajar hynriew spah ngut.
U la buh hynñiew phew hajar na ki ban kit jingkit, phraphew hajar ban tih maw ha ri lum, bad laihajar hynriewspah ngut kum ki sordar ban pyntrei kam ïa ki briew.

Te u Solomon u la sdang ban tei ïa ka ïing u Trai ha Jerusalem halor u lum Moria, ha ka jaka ba u Trai U la paw ha u Dabid u kpa jong u, thik ha kata ka jaka ba u Dabid u la buh dak, ha ka kyntem u Ornan nong Jebus.
U la sdang ban tei ïa ka ha u bnai ba-ar jong ka snem ka basaw jong ka jinglong syiem jong u.
Kine ki long ki jynthew jong u Solomon ban tei ïa ka ïing u Blei: ka lynter ha ki pruh barim ka la long hynriewphew pruh, bad ka pyngkiang arphew pruh.

Ka batsha hakhmat jong ka ïingpdeng ka long arphew pruh ka lynter, mar katjuh kat ka pynkiang jong ka ïing, bad ka kynjang ka la long shispah arphew pruh. U la sop ïa ka na shapoh da ka ksiar banylla.
U la sop ïa ka ïingpdeng da ki dieng kseh, nangta u la suit nalor da ka ksiar ka bani, bad u la oh shrong halor jong ka da ki dieng tlai bad ki kynjri.
U la pynriam ïa ka ïing da ki mawkordor. Ka ksiar ka dei kaba na Parbaim.
Kumta u la sop ïa ka ïing da ka ksiar, ïa ki khnong, ïa ki shawkad, ïa ki kynroh bad ïa ki jynkhang jong ka; halor ki kynroh pat u la oh ki dur kherubim.

U la thaw sa ïa ka jaka kyntang tam. Ka lynter jong ka, marshak bad ka pyngkiang jong ka ïing, ka la long arphew pruh, bad ka pyngkiang jong ka arphew pruh. U la suit nalor da ka ksiar ka bani hynriewspah talen.
Ka jingkhia ki prek ksiar ka la long sanphew shekel. U la suit da ka ksiar ïa ki kamra ki bashaneng.
Ha ka jaka bakyntang tam u la thaw ar tylli ki kherubim kiba da ka dieng bad u la suit ïa ki da ka ksiar.

Ki thapniang jong ki kherubim na tduh ha tduh ki la long arphew pruh. Ka thapniang jong uwei, san pruh, ka la kot haduh kynroh jong ka ïing, bad kawei pat ka thapniang, san pruh, ka la kot ïa ka thapniang jong uwei pat u kherub.
Ka thapniang jong uwei pat u kherub ruh, san pruh, ka kot ïa ka kynroh jong ka ïing, bad kawei pat ka thapniang, san pruh kane ruh, ka ïakynduh bad ka thapniang jong u kherub u banyngkong.
Ki thapniang jong kine ki kherubim ki ïar arphew pruh, bad ki kherubim ki ïeng ha la ki kjat, ki phai khmat sha ka ïingpdeng.
U la thaw ka jynkah kaba da ki jaiñ bajngum, basawbthuh bad basawsyngiang bad da ka linen bani, bad u la thaiñ ki dur kherubim halor jong ka.
Hakhmat jong ka ïing u la pynïeng ar tylli ki rishot kiba jrong laiphew san pruh, bad ha kliar jong uwei uwei la don ka khlieh kaba jrong san pruh.
U la thaw ki kynjri kiba kum u kpieng bad u la wah ïa ki ha kliar jong ki rishot; u la thaw sa ki soh pomkranet shispah tylli, bad u la buh ïa ki halor kita ki kynjri.
U la pynïeng ïa kita ki rishot hakhmat ka tempyl, uwei sha kamon bad uwei pat sha kadiang. Ïa uba sha kamon u la ai kyrteng Jakhin, ïa uba sha kadiang u la ai kyrteng Boaz.
U la thaw ka duwan kaba da ka rnong, arphew pruh ka lynter, arphew pruh ka pyngkiang, bad shiphew pruh ka pynïeng.
Nangta u la thaw sa ka dabor ba shu saiñ. Ka la long ka bapyllun, shiphew pruh na rymmiang sha rymmiang, ka kynjang san pruh, bad ka lyngwiar laiphew pruh haba thew da u ksai.
Ha bar jong ka don ki dur masi dab, kumba laiphew pruh, ba ki tawiar sawdong ka dabor. Ki masi dab ki la long ar kyrwat, ba la saiñ lang bad ka, haba saiñ ïa ka.

Ka la ïeng halor khat-ar tylli ki masi dab, lai tylli ki phai khmat shatei, lai tylli ki phai khmat sha sepngi, lai tylli ki phai khmat shathie, bad lai tylli ki phai khmat sha mihngi. Ïa ka dabor la pynshong halor ki skhep jong ki, kiba phai shapoh.
Ka jingrben jong ka shi khup, bad ka rymmiang jong ka kum ka rymmiang khuri, kum ka rymmiang u ’tiewlili. Ka ngiam palat laihajar phiang um sum.

U la thaw ruh shiphew tylli ki dabor ban sait jingsait, bad u la buh san tylli sha kamon bad san tylli sha kadiang. Ha kine ki dei ban sait pynkhuid ïa kaba pyndonkam na ka bynta ka jingkñia thang; bad ka dabor ka long ban sum ban sait ki lyngdoh.
U la thaw shiphew tylli ki jynpynïeng sharak kiba da ka ksiar kumba la hukum, bad u la buh ïa ki ha tempyl, san tylli shaphang kamon bad san tylli sha kadiang.
U la thaw ruh shiphew tylli ki miej, bad u la buh ïa ki ha ka tempyl, san tylli sha kamon bad san tylli sha ka diang. U la thaw ruh shispah tylli ki khuri ksiar.
U la thaw sa ïa ka mynshem jong ki lyngdoh, bad ka mynshem ka baheh kaba don ki jynkhang, bad u la sop ïa ki jynkhang da ka rnong.
Ïa ka dabor u la pynshong ha ka dong kamon jong ka ïing shaphang shathie lam mihngi.
U Huram u la thaw ruh ki khiew, ki siang bad ki khuri. Kumta u Huram u la pyndep ha ïing u Blei ïa ki kam ba phah u syiem Solomon:
ki rishot ar tylli, ki khuri, ki khlieh ar tylli ha kliar ki rishot bad ki jynthaiñ jar ar tylli ban tap ïa ki ar tylli ki khuri halor khlieh kiba don ha kliar ki rishot;

bad ki sawspah tylli ki soh pomkranet na ka bynta ki ar tylli ki jynthaiñ jar (ar lain ki pomkranet ïa kawei kawei ka jynthaiñ jar), ban tap ïa ki ar tylli ki khuri jong ki khlieh kiba don ha kliar ki rishot.
U la thaw ruh ki jynkyrshan, bad ki dabor halor ki jynkyrshan,
kawei ka dabor, bad ki masi dab khat-ar tylli kiba hapoh jong ka.
Ïa ki khiew, ki siang, ki proh bad baroh ki tiar ki tar, u Huram-Abi u la thaw na ka rnong phyrnai na ka bynta u syiem Solomon na ka bynta ka ïing u Trai.
U syiem u la saiñ ïa ki ha ka dewbyrtha kaba hapdeng Sukkoth bad Zereda ha ka madan Jordan.
U Solomon u la thaw ïa kine kiei kiei baroh shikatdei bah haduh ba ym lah tip shuh ïa ka jingkhia ka rnong.
Kumta u Solomon u la thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba la don ha ki ïing u Blei: ki la long ka duwan ksiar, ki miej na ka bynta u kpu pyni,
ki jynpynïeng sharak bad ki sharak jong ki kiba da ka ksiar banylla ban thang ïa ki, kumba la hukum, ha ka jaka kyntang bashapoh;
nangta ki syntiew, ki sharak, bad ki nap, kiba da ka ksiar banylla tam;

ki jynpynlip sharak, ki dabor, ki pliang dhup, bad ki pliang ding, kiba da ka ksiar ka banylla. Ki jynkhang ka tempyl, ki jynkhang sha ka jaka kyntang tam bad ki jynkhang ka ïingpdeng ka tempyl, ki la long da ka ksiar.

Kumta ka kam baroh ba u Solomon u la pyntrei na ka bynta ka ïing u Trai ka la dep. U Solomon u la wan rah ïa kiei kiei ba u Dabid u kpa jong u u la aiti kyntang, bad u la buh ïa ka rupa, ka ksiar, bad ki khiew ki pliang baroh ha ki jynkynshew ka ïing u Blei.

Te u Solomon u la lum lang ïa ki tymmen ki san ka Israel, ïa ki rangbah baroh jong ki jait, bad ïa ki rangbah jong ki ïing kur ki paid Israel, ha Jerusalem, ban wan rah noh ïa ka synduk jutang u Trai na Zion, ka Nongbah u Dabid.
Baroh ki rangbah Israel ki la ïalum lang hakhmat u syiem ha ka sngi leh burom kaba hap ha u bnai u bahynñiew.
Ki tymmen ki san Israel baroh ki la wan, bad ki Lebi ki la rah ïa ka synduk.
Ki la wan rah ïa ka synduk, ïa ka ïingjaiñ jingïakynduh bad ïa ki khiew ki pliang bakhuid baroh kiba don ha ka ïingjaiñ. Ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ki la wan rah ïa ki.
U syiem Solomon bad ki paidlang Israel baroh kiba la ïalum lang bad u, ki la don hakhmat ka synduk. Ki la kñia ki langbrot bad ki masi dab shikatdei bah haduh ba ym lah ñiew lah kheiñ shuh ïa ki.
Kumta ki lyngdoh ki la rah ïa ka synduk jutang sha ka jaka jong ka, sha ka jaka kyntang kaba shapoh jong ka tempyl, ha ka jaka bakyntang tam, hapoh ki thapniang jong ki kherubim.
Ki kherubim ki piar ïa ki thapniang halor ka jaka ba don ka synduk, ha kata ka rukom ba ki kherubim ki tap nalor ïa ka synduk bad ïa ki dieng jingbah.

Ki dieng ki jrong haduh katta katta ba ïa ki tduh jong ki lah ban ïohi na ka jaka bakhuid hakhmat ka jaka kyntang bashapoh. Hynrei ym lah ban ïohi ïa ki na shabar, bad ki dang don hangta haduh kane ka sngi.
Ym don ei ei hapoh ka synduk lait tang ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap kiba u Moses u la buh hangta ha Horeb mynba u Trai U la ïateh jutang bad u paid Israel, haba ki la mih na ri Ijipt.
Te haba ki lyngdoh ki la mih na ka jaka bakhuid (ki lyngdoh baroh kiba ïadon ki la pynkhuid ïa lade, lada ki dei na kano kano ka kyrdan),

baroh ki Lebi nongrwai, u Asaph, u Heman, bad u Jeduthun, ki khun shynrang jong ki bad ki kur ki jait, ha la ki riam da ki jaiñ linen bani, lem bad ki ’singpadiah, ki duitara bad ki marynthing, ki la ïeng shaphang mihngi jong ka duwan ryngkat bad shispah arphew ngut ki lyngdoh nongput turoi.

(Ka la long ka deiti jong ki nongput turoi bad ki nongrwai ban pynsngew kum kawei ka sur haba ki ïaroh bad ki ainguh ïa u Trai). Te haba ïa ka jingrwai la pynjam lem bad ki turoi, ki ’singpadiah bad kiwei pat ki jyntem jynput, ban ïaroh ïa u Trai, “Naba U long u babha, ka jingieid sbun jong U ka ïaisah junom,” ka ïing u Trai ka la dap da u lyoh,
haduh ba ki lyngdoh kim lah shuh ban leh niam namar uta u lyoh: ka Burom jong u Trai ka la pyndap ïa ka ïing u Blei.
Te u Solomon u la ong, “U Trai U la jied ban shong ha u lyoh u barben.
Nga la thaw ka ïing ka ba-iphieng na ka bynta jong Me, ka jaka ba Men shong sah junom.”
Nangta u syiem u la phai bad u la kyrkhu ïa uta u paid Israel, katba u paidbah Israel baroh u dang ïeng.
Te u la ong, “Long ba la kyrkhu u Trai, u Blei ki Israel, Uba la pyndep da ka kti jong U ïa kata kaba U la kular da ka shyntur jong U ha u Dabid u kpa jong nga, haba U la ong,

‘Naduh ka sngi ba Nga la ïalam noh ïa u paid jong Nga na ri Ijipt, Ngam shym la jied ïa kano kano ka shnong na ki jait Israel baroh ban tei ka ïing hangta, ba ka kyrteng jong Nga kan ïoh sah ha ka, bad Ngam shym la jied ïa uno uno u briew ban long u rangbah nongïalam ïa ki paid Israel jong Nga.
Nga la jied pynban ïa ka Jerusalem ba ka kyrteng jong Nga kan ïoh sah hangta, bad Nga la jied ïa u Dabid ban long u rangbah halor ki paid Israel jong Nga.
Te ka la long ka jingkwah u Dabid u kpa jong nga ban tei ka ïing na ka bynta ka kyrteng u Trai u Blei ki Israel.
Hynrei u Trai U la ong ha u Dabid, u kpa jong nga, ‘Ka long ka babha ba phi don ka jingkwah ban tei ka ïing na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong Nga.
La kumta ruh, phin ym tei ïa kata ka ïing, hynrei u khun ba yn sa kha na phi un sa tei ïa kata ka ïing na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong Nga.’

Mynta u Trai U la pyndep ïa la ka jingkular ba U la kren. Nga la mihbteng ïa u kpa jong nga u Dabid, bad nga shong halor ka khet Israel, kumba u Trai U la kular, bad nga la tei ka ïing na ka bynta ka kyrteng u Trai u Blei ki Israel.
Nga la buh hangta ïa ka synduk, ha kaba don ka jutang u Trai kaba U la ïateh bad ki paid Israel.”
Te u Solomon u la ïeng hakhmat ka duwan u Trai hakhmat u paidlang Israel baroh, bad u la pyiar ïa ki kti.

U Solomon u la thaw ka rynsan rnong kaba san pruh ka lynter, san pruh ka pyngkiang bad lai pruh ka kynjang, bad u la pynïeng ïa ka ha ka phyllaw. Ynda u la kiew halor jong ka, u la dem khohsiew hakhmat u paidlang Israel baroh bad u la kner ïa la ki kti sha bneng.

Te u la ong, “A Trai u Blei ki Israel, ym don Blei Uba kat ma Me, ha bneng ne ha khyndew; Me bat ïa la ka jutang bad Me pynpaw ïa la ka jingieid ka baskhem ïa ki shakri jong Me kiba ïaid ha ka lynti jong Me da ka dohnud baroh.
Me la bat ïa kata kaba Me la kular ha u shakri jong Me u Dabid u kpa jong nga. Da ka shyntur jong Me Me la kren bad da ka kti jong Me la pyndep ïa ka mynta ka sngi.

Te mynta, a Trai u Blei ki Israel, to bat ïa kata kaba Me la kular ha u shakri jong Me u Dabid u kpa jong nga haba Me la ong, ‘Phin ym duh u nongmih bteng uban shong hakhmat jong Nga halor ka khet Israel, lada ki khun jong Me kim phikir, ha la ka ïaid ka ïeng, ban bud ïa ka aiñ jong Nga kumba Me Me la leh.’
Namarkata, a Trai u Blei ki Israel, to pynshisha ïa ka ktien kaba Me la kren ha u shakri jong Me u Dabid.
“Hynrei shisha shisha u Blei Un shong Un sah ma bad u briew ha ka khyndew? Lada ka bneng, wat ka bneng kaba ha khlieh tam kam ngiam satia ïa Me, katno lei lei kane ka ïing kaba nga la tei!
La kumta ruh to shah shkor ïa ka jingduwai bad ka jingkyrpad u shakri jong Me, a Trai u Blei jong nga; to shah shkor ïa ka jingpyrta bad ka jingduwai ba u shakri jong Me u duwai hakhmat jong Me;

khnang ba ki khmat jong Me kin dup peit synñia sngi sha kane ka ïing, ka jaka ha kaba Me la kular ban pynsah ïa la ka kyrteng, ba Men dup shah shkor ïa ka jingduwai kaba u shakri jong Me u tyrwa ha kane ka jaka.
“To shah shkor ïa ki jingkyrpad jong u shakri jong Me bad jong ki paid jong Me ki Israel, haba ki duwai da kaba phai sha kane ka jaka. To sngap na bneng, ka jaka shong jong Me; to sngap, bad to map.
“Lada u briew u leh sniew pyrshah u para marjan bad ïa u la phah smai, kumta u wan ban smai hakhmat ka duwan jong Me ha kane ka ïing,

ma Me to sngap na bneng, shim bishar ïa ki shakri jong Me, nangta sa ai ka nongkylliang ïa u ’riewsniew da kaba pynkit ïa ka jingleh jong u halor ka khlieh jong u hi, bad sa pynksan ïa u bahok da kaba ai bainong ïa u katkum ka hok jong u.
“Lada ki paid jong Me ki shah jop ha ki nongshun namarba ki la leh bymman pyrshah ïa Me, bad lada ki wan phai sha Me bad ki phla ïa ka kyrteng jong Me, ki duwai bad ki kyrpad ïa Me ha kane ka ïing,
to sngap ma Me na bneng bad to map ïa ka jingleh bymman ki paid jong Me ki Israel, to ai biang ha ki ïa ka ri ba Me la ai ha ki bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki.

“Haba ïa ka bneng la khang bad ym don slap namarba ki la leh pap pyrshah ïa Me, lada ki duwai da kaba phai sha kane ka jaka, ki phla ïa ka kyrteng jong Me, bad ki phai na ka pap jong ki ynda Me la pynshitom ïa ki,

to sngap ma Me na bneng, bad to map ïa ka pap ki shakri jong Me ki paid jong Me ki Israel, ynda Me hikai ha ki ïa ka lynti babha ba ki dei ban ïaid; nangta to phah ïa u slap halor ka ri jong Me, kaba Me la ai ha ki kum ka ri kynti.

“Lada don ’nemsniew ha ka ri, lada don ka khlam, ne ka jingïap tram, ne ka jingïap ïong, ne u puit suwa, ne u puit khlam; lada ki nongshun jong ki ki kerkut ïa ki ha kano kano ka nongbah; lada don kano kano ka jingïap them ne ka jingpang;
lada uno uno u briew ne ki paid jong Me baroh ki Israel, ki duwai ne ki kyrpad kumno kumno, da kaba sngewthuh ïa la ka jingjynjar bad ka jingkhuslai, bad da kaba kner ïa la ki kti sha kane ka ïing;
to sngap ma Me na bneng, ka jaka shong jong Me, bad to map, bad to ai ha uwei pa uwei kumba u dawa (naba ma Me, tang ma Me hi, Me ithuh ïa ki dohnud jong u khun bynriew).
Kumta to kin tiengburom ïa Me bad kin ïaid ha ki lynti jong Me katba ki dang im ha ka ri kaba Me la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi.

“Ïa u nongwei nong-ar ruh ubym don jingïadei bad u paid Israel jong Me, uba wan na ka ri bajngai ban burom ïa ka kyrteng jong Me ka bakhraw, ïa ka kti jong Me ka badonbor, bad ïa ka ksangkti jong Me ka bakner, haba u wan ban duwai sha kane ka ïing,

to sngap ma Me na bneng, ka jaka shong jong Me, bad to leh kumba uta u nongwei u khot kyrpad ïa Me, khnang ba ki paid bynriew baroh jong ka khyndew kin dup tip ïa ka kyrteng jong Me bad kin dup tiengburom ïa Me, kumba leh ki paid Israel jong Me, bad hangta kin tip ba ïa kane ka ïing ba nga la tei la aiti kyntang ha ka burom jong Me.

“Lada ki paid jong Me ki leit ïaleh thma ïa ki nongshun jong ki, da kano kano ka rukom ba Me phah ïa ki, bad ki duwai ïa Me da kaba phai sha kane ka nongbah ba Me la jied bad ka ïing ba nga la tei na ka bynta ka burom jong Me,
to shah shkor ma Me na bneng ïa ka jingduwai bad ka jingkyrpad jong ki, bad to ïada ïa ka hok jong ki.
“Lada ki leh pap pyrshah ïa Me—naba ym don briew ubym leh pap—Me Me bitar ïa ki bad Me aiti ïa ki ha u nongshun, kumta ki shah ring koidi sha kawei pat ka ri kaba jan ne jngai,

pynban lada ki sngewbabe ha kata ka ri ba ki la shah ring koidi, bad ki kylla bamut, bad ki kyrpad kyrpon ïa Me ha kata ka ri shong koidi, da kaba ong, ‘Ngi la leh pap bad ngi la leh mutlop bad ngi la leh kam bymman,’

lada ki la kylla kaba mut da ka jingmut bad ka dohnud jong ki baroh, ha kata ka ri ba ki shah ringmraw, bad ki duwai da kaba phai sha ka ri jong ki kaba Me la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki, sha ka nongbah kaba Me la jied bad sha ka ïing ba nga la tei na ka bynta ka burom jong Me,

ma Me na bneng, ka jaka shong jong Me, to shah shkor ïa ka jingduwai bad ka jingkyrpad kyrpon jong ki, bad to ïada ïa ka hok jong ki, bad to map artat ïa ki paid jong Me kiba la leh sniew pyrshah ïa Me.
Mynta, a Blei jong nga, to peit ïa la ki khmat bad to pynshah ïa la ki shkor ïa ka jingduwai jong kane ka jaka.

“Te mynta to ïeng, a Trai u Blei, to wan sha ka jaka shongthait jong Me, ma Me bad ka synduk jong ka bor jong Me. To ki lyngdoh jong Me, a Trai u Blei, kin phong da ka jingpynim, to ki riewkhuid jong Me kin shadkmen ha ka jingmanbha.
A Trai u Blei, wat kyntait ïa ka jingkyrpad jong u ba la sleh jong Me! To kynmaw ïa ka jingieid thep mynsiem jong Me ïa u Dabid u shakri jong Me.”
Haba u Solomon u la kut ka jingduwai, ka ding ka la wan hiar na bneng. Ka la bam duh ïa ka jyntyrwa thang bad ïa ki jynkñia, bad ka burom jong u Trai ka la pyndap ïa ka tempyl.
Ki lyngdoh kim shym lah ban rung hapoh ka ïing u Trai, namarba ka burom jong u Trai ka la pyndap ïa ka.

Haba ki Israel baroh ki la ïohi ïa ka ding ba ka wan hiar, bad ïa ka burom u Trai ha ka tempyl, ki la dem pyllup haduh khyndew ha ka jaka basiang, ki la mane bad ki ainguh ïa u Trai, da kaba ong, “Naba U long u babha, naba ka jingieid sbun jong U ka ïaisah junom.”
Nangta u syiem bad ki paidbah baroh ki la tyrwa jynkñia hakhmat u Trai.
U syiem Solomon u la tyrwa kum ka jynkñia arphew ar hajar tylli ki masi dab bad shispah arphew hajar tylli ki langbrot. Kumta u syiem bad ki paidbah baroh ki la pynkyntang ïa ka ïing u Blei.

Ki lyngdoh ki la ïeng ha la ki jaka; kumjuh ruh ki Lebi bad la ki tiar rwai jingrwai ha u Trai kiba u syiem Dabid u la thaw ban ainguh ïa u Trai—“Naba ka jingieid sbun jong U ka ïaineh junom”—kat haba u Dabid u phah ïa ki ban ïarap lem ïa ki jingïaroh. Mar pyrshah jong ki, ki lyngdoh ki la put ïa ki turoi; ki Israel baroh ki la ïeng.

Nangta pat u Solomon u la pynkyntang ïa ka phyllaw pdeng kaba hakhmat ka ïing u Trai. Dei hangta ba u la tyrwa ïa ka jyntyrwa thang bad ïa ka khleiñ jong ki jynkñia Jingsuk, namarba ka duwan rnong ba shna u Solomon kam ngiam ïa ka jynkñia thang, ka jynkñia jynbam bad ka khleiñ.
Ha kata ka por u Solomon u la pynlong ka jingkhawai niam kumba hynñiew sngi lem bad ki Israel baroh shikatdei bah kiba naduh lynti khim Hamath haduh wahduid Ijipt.
Ha ka sngi ka baphra ki la pynlong ka jingïalang ka ba-ishongkun, namar ki la pynneh ïa ka jingpynkyntang ïa ka duwan hynñiew sngi bad ïa ka jingkhawai niam hynñiew sngi.

Ha ka sngi ka ba-arphewlai jong u bnai u bahynñiew, u la phah noh ïa ki briew sha la ki ïing : ki la dap da ka jingkmen bad ka jingsngewbha na ka bynta ka jingbha ba u Trai U la pyni ha u Dabid, ha u Solomon bad ha ki Israel ki paidbah jong U.
Kumta u Solomon u la pyndep ïa ka ïing jong u Trai bad ïa ka ïing syiem. U la pyndep haban da biang bha ïa kiei kiei baroh ba u la mut dur ban leh shaphang ka ïing u Trai bad ka ïing lajong.
Te u Trai U la paw ha u Solomon, mynmiet bad U la ong ha u, “Nga la sngap sngewbha ïa ka jingduwai jong phi: Nga jied ïa kane ka jaka na ka bynta ïa lade kum ka ïing jingkñia.
Lada Nga khang ïa ka bneng ban ym don slap, ne Nga hukum ïa u puit suwa ban bam duh ïa ka ri, lane Nga phah ïa ka khlam hapdeng ki briew jong Nga,

hynrei lada ki briew jong Nga kiba don ïa ka kyrteng jong Nga ki pynrit ïa lade, ki duwai bad ki wad ïa ka khmat jong Nga, bad ki ieh noh artat ïa ki lynti bymman, hangta Ngan shah shkor ïa ki na bneng, Ngan map ïa ka pap jong ki bad Ngan pynim biang ïa ka ri jong ki.
Mynta ki khmat jong Nga kin sa peit, bad ki shkor kin sa sngap ïa ka jingduwai kaba na kane ka jaka.
Namar mynta Nga la jied bad Nga la pynkyntang ïa kane ka ïing ba ka kyrteng jong Nga kan dup don hangne junom. Ki khmat jong Nga bad ka dohnud jong Nga kin don hangne barabor.

Shaphang jong phi pat de, lada phi ïaid hakhmat jong Nga kumba la ïaid u Dabid u kpa jong phi, da kaba leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kumba Nga la hukum ïa phi bad da kaba rakhe ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong Nga,
Ngan sa pynskhem ïa ka khet syiem jong phi kumba Nga la ïateh jutang bad u kpa jong phi u Dabid, haba Nga la ong, ‘Phin ym duh u nongmih bteng uban synshar ïa ka Israel’.
“Hynrei lada phi phai kynriang bad phi lyndet ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong Nga kiba Nga la buh hakhmat jong phi, bad phi leit ban shakri bad ban mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei,

hangta Ngan rat ïa ki Israel na ka ri kaba Nga la ai ha ki; bad ïa kane ka ïing kaba Nga la pynkyntang na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong Nga, Ngan sa kyntait nakhmat jong Nga, bad Ngan sa pynlong ïa ka ka nuksa bad ka jingkynshi hapdeng ki jait bynriew baroh.
Shaphang kane ka ïing ba la kyntiew nam, kat uba ïaid lait najan un sa lyngngoh lyngngaiñ, bad un sa ong, ‘Balei sha u Trai U la leh kumne ïa kane ka ri bad kane ka ïing?’

Hangta kin sa ïa-ong, ‘Dei namarba ki la lyndet ïa u Trai u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki, Uba la wan ïalam ïa ki na ri Ijipt, bad namarba ki la kynthup ïa kiwei pat ki blei, ki la mane bad shakri ïa ki. Na kane ka daw U la pynngat ïa kane ka jinglanot halor jong ki.’ ”
Ynda la kut ki arphew snem haba u Solomon u la tei ïa ka ïing u Trai bad ïa ka ïing lajong,
u Solomon u la tei pynbha ïa ki shnong kiba u Huram u la ai ïa u, bad u la pynshong ïa ki Israel hangta.
Te u Solomon u la hiar thma ïa ka Hamath-Zoba bad u la jop ïa ka.
U la tei ïa ka Tadmor kaba ha ri kynjah bad ïa ki shnong buh jynbam, kiba u la tei ha Hamath.
U la tei sa ïa ka Beth-Horon Bashaneng bad ïa ka Beth-Horon Basharum, u la pynkhlaiñ ïa ki shnong da ki kynroh, ki khyrdop bad ki nar khang;

nangta ïa ka Baalath, bad ïa ki shnong buh jynbam baroh kiba u Solomon u la don, ïa ki shnong baroh na ka bynta ki kali jong u, ïa ki shnong na ka bynta ki nongshong kulai jong u, bad ïa kiei kiei katba u Solomon u la kwah ban tei ha Jerusalem, ha Lebanon, bad ha ka ri baroh ba u synshar.
Ïa ki jait bynriew baroh kiba dang sah na ki Hit, ki Amor, ki Peris, ki Hib bad ki Jebus, ba kim dei jait Israel,
ïa ki khun ki kti jong kine, ba ki dang shong dang sah ha ka ri namarba ki paid Israel kim shym pynduh ïa ki—ïa kine u Solomon u la pyntrei kam khalasi, bad ki dang trei kumta haduh mynta mynne.
Hynrei u Solomon um shym pynbor ïa ki Israel na ka bynta ki kam jong u. Kine ki la trei kam pyrton, ki la long rangbah pynïaidkam, rangbah ïa ki pyrton kali, bad ki nongshong kulai jong u.
Kine ki la long rangbah duh jong u Solomon, arspah sanphew ngut, bad ki la don ka bor ka iktiar halor u paidbah.

U Solomon u la wan ïalam ïa ka khun u Pharo na ka Nongbah u Dabid sha ka ïing ba u la tei na ka bynta jong ka, namar u la ong, “Ka tnga jong nga kam dei ban shong ha ka ïing u Dabid syiem Israel, namar ki jaka ha kiba ka synduk u Trai ka la wan ki long ki bakhuid.
Te u Solomon u la tyrwa ki jynkñia thang ha u Trai halor ka duwan u Trai kaba u tei hakhmat ka batsha,

kat haba don kam katkum ka hukum u Moses na ka bynta ki sngi sabath, ki ’naithymmai bad ki jinglehniam kiba lai sien shisnem—ka niam ka rukom leh niam u ’Pu khlemthiat, ka niam ka rukom niam ki Taïew, bad ka niam ka rukom ki Ïingtrep.

Katkum ka riti niam u Dabid u kpa jong u, u la thung ki lyngdoh ki ban ïapli sngi na ka bynta ki jinglehniam jong ki, bad ki Lebi na ka bynta ki kam jingïaroh bad jinglehniam hakhmat ki lyngdoh kumba dawa ka kam. Ki nongap khyrdop ki la ïapli sngi ha ki khyrdop, kumba u Dabid u briew u Blei u la lah hukum.
Kim shym kynriah na kata kaba u syiem u la hukum ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi shaphang kano kano ka kam bad ki jynkynshew.
Kumta la trei haban da dep ïa ka kam u Solomon naduh ka sngi ba la buh nongrim ïa ka ïing u Trai. Ha kane ka rukom ka ïing u Trai ka la dep nadong shadong.
Te u Solomon u la leit sha Ezion-Geber bad Elath harud duriaw ha ri Edom.

U Huram u la phah sha u ki lieng da ki maji jong u hi kiba tip shaphang ka duriaw. Ki la leit lang bad ki shakri u Solomon sha Ophir, bad ki la wan kit nangta sawspah sanphew talen ka ksiar, bad ki la rah ïa ka sha u Solomon.

Haba ka syiem Sheba ka la ïohsngew ïa ka nam u Solomon, ka la wan sha Jerusalem lem bad bun byllien ki nongbud, bad ki ut kiba kit ki jyniwbih, shibun bah ka ksiar bad ki mawkordor, ban tynjuh ïa u Solomon da ki jingkylli ki ba-eh. Ynda poi ha u Solomon, ka la ïathuh lut ha u katba don ha ka jingmut jong ka.
U Solomon u la jubab ïa ki jingkylli jong ka baroh, bad ym don ei ei kaba rieh na u Solomon ba um shym lah ban batai ha ka.
Te haba ka syiem Sheba ka la ïohi ïa ka jingstad u Solomon, ïa ka ïing ba u la tei,

ïa ka jynbam ha ka miej jong u, ïa ka jaka shong jaka sah ki myntri, ïa ka rukom shakri ki shakri bad ïa ki riam jong ki, ïa ki nongrah khuri bad ïa ki riam jong ki, bad ïa ki jynkñia thang kiba u la tyrwa ha ka ïing u Trai, ka la ang lyngngoh ngaiñ.
Te ka la ong ha u syiem, “Ka jingbna kaba nga la ïohsngew ha ka ri jong nga shaphang ki kam ki jam bad ka jingstad jong phi ka long ka bashisha.

Ngam shym ngeit ïa ka jingbna tat haduh ba nga la wan ïohi hi da ki khmat lajong. Da shisha, ym shym ïathuh ha nga wat shiteng na ka jingstad jong phi; phi palat liam ïa ka jingbna ba nga la ïohsngew.
Donbok u khun u hajar jong phi ! Donbok kine ki shakri jong phi kiba ïeng barabor hakhmat jong phi bad kiba ïohsngew ïa ka jingstad jong phi !

Long ba la kyrkhu u Trai u Blei jong phi, Uba la sngewbha ïa phi bad la pynshong ïa phi halor ka khet jong U kum u syiem na ka bynta u Trai u Blei jong phi ! Namarba u Blei jong phi U ieid ïa ka Israel bad U kwah ban pynneh ïa ka junom, U la pynlong syiem ïa phi halor jong ki, ba phin dup pynïaid ïa ka aiñ bad ka jingleh hok.”
Kumta ka la ai sngewbha ïa u syiem shispah arphew talen ka ksiar, bad shikatdei bah ki jyniwbih bad ki mawkordor. Ym pat ju don musla iwbih kat kito kiba ka syiem Sheba ka la ai ha u Solomon.
Nalor kata ki shakri u Huram bad ki shakri u Solomon kiba la wan rah ksiar na Ophir, ki la wan rah ruh ki dieng alkum bad ki mawkordor.

Da kita ki dieng alkum, u syiem u la thaw ki kyrdon jynkieng na ka bynta ka ïing u Trai bad ka ïing syiem, ki marynthing bad ki duitara na ka bynta ki nongrwai. Ym pat ju ïohi kum kine mynshuwa ha ri Juda.

U syiem Solomon u la ai ïa ka syiem Sheba baroh katba ka kwah, baroh katba ka pan nalor ki jynai markylliang ïa kiba ka la wan rah ïa u syiem. Hadien kata ka la leit phai sha la ka ri lem bad ki nongbud jong ka.
Ka jingkhia ka ksiar kaba poi ha u Solomon ha ka shi snem ka la long hynriewspah hynriewphew hynriew talen ka ksiar,
nalor kaba u ïoh na ki nongkhaïi bad ki mahajon. Baroh ki syiem Arabia bad ki lat jong ka ri ki la wan rah ka ksiar bad ka rupa ïa u Solomon.
U syiem Solomon u la thaw arspah tylli ki stieh kiba da ka ksiar ba shu shoh, bad ha kawei kawei ka stieh ka leit hynriew spah talen ka ksiar ba shu shoh.
U la thaw pat laispah tylli ki stieh ba shu shoh bad ha kawei kawei ka stieh ka leit laispah talen ka ksiar. U syiem u la buh ïa kine ha ka ïing Khlaw Lebanon.
U syiem u la thaw ruh ka khet bniat hati ka baheh, bad u la suit ïa ka da ka ksiar banylla.

Ka khet ka la don hynriew kyrdon bad ka jynïuh kjat kaba da ka ksiar, bad la pyndait ïa kine bad ka khet; baroh arliang ka khet la don ki jynkyrshan kti, bad hamar syndah ki jynkyrshan kti la don ar tylli ki sing kiba ïeng.
Ha tduh jong kawei pa kawei ka kyrdon, baroh arliang ki hynriew kyrdon, la don khat-ar tylli ki sing kiba ïeng. Kaba kum kane ym pat ju thaw ha kano kano ka hima.
Baroh ki khiew dih u syiem Solomon ki dei da ka ksiar, bad baroh ki khiew ki pliang kiba don ha ka ïing Khlaw Lebanon ki long da ka ksiar banylla. Ïa ka rupa ym da ñiew kor eh ha ki sngi u Solomon.
Ki lieng u syiem ki leit sha Tarshish lem bad ki maji u Huram; shisien lai snem ki lieng Tarshish ki ju wan kit ka ksiar, ka rupa, ki bniat hati, ki huleng bad ki klew.
Kumta u syiem Solomon u la palat ïa ki syiem baroh jong ka pyrthei ha ka spah bad ka jingstad.
Baroh ki syiem jong ka pyrthei ki la wad ban ïakynduh bad u Solomon, ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingstad jong u kaba u Blei U la buh ha ka jingmut jong u.
Kat uba wan u la wan rah jynai sngewbha, da ki mar rupa bad ksiar, da ki jaiñkup, ka mir, ki musla iwbih, ki kulai, bad ki khashor man la ka snem.
U Solomon u la don sawhajar tylli ki sem na ka bynta ki kulai bad ki kali, bad khat-ar hajar ngut ki nongshong kulai ïa kiba u buh ha ki shnong buh kali bad ha Jerusalem hajan u syiem.
U la synshar halor ki syiem baroh naduh ka Ïuphratis shaduh ka ri ki Philistia, bad haduh khappud Ijipt.
U la pynlong ïa ka rupa ba kan kynrei ha Jerusalem kum ki maw, bad ïa ki dieng kedar ba kin pahuh kum ki dieng dymbur ha Shephela.
Ïa ki kulai na ka bynta u Solomon la wan rah na Ijipt bad na ki ri baroh.

Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Solomon, naduh basdang haduh bakut, la thoh ha ka jingïathuh khana u Nathan Nongïathuhlypa, bad ha ka jingïathuh lypa u Ahija nong Shilon, bad ha ki jingïohi paw u Iddo u kunok shaphang u Jeroboam u khun u Nebat.
U Solomon u la synshar ha Jerusalem halor ki Israel baroh sawphew snem.
U Solomon u la ïohthiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u bad la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid u kpa jong u. U Rehoboam u khun jong u u la mihbteng ïa u.
U Rehoboam u la leit sha Shekhem namarba ki Israel baroh ki la ïaleit sha Shekhem ban thung syiem ïa u.
Haba u Jeroboam u khun u Nebat u la ïohsngew ïa kata (namar u la phet sha Ijipt na u syiem Solomon), u la wan phai na Ijipt.
Te ki la phah khot ïa u, kumta u Jeroboam u la wan lang bad ki Israel baroh sha u Rehoboam, bad ki la ong ha u,
“U kpa jong phi u la buh ka lyngkor ka bakhia halor jong ngi. Mynta to pynsting ïa ka jingpyntrei shitom u kpa jong phi bad ïa ka lyngkor bakhia ba u la pynkit ha ngi, te kumta ngin shakri ïa phi.”
U la ong ha ki, “Sa wan biang sha nga hadien lai sngi.” Kumta ki paidbah ki la leit noh.
Te u syiem Rehoboam u la wad jingmut na ki ’riewtymmen kiba la ju don bad u Solomon u kpa jong u mynba u dang im, bad u la ong, “Kumno phi ai jingmut ïa nga ban jubab ïa kine ki paid?”
Ki la ong ha u, “Lada phi leh sbun ïa kine ki paidbah bad phi pynsngewbha ïa ki, da kaba kren ki ktien ki bajem ïa ki, kin shakri ïa phi junom.”
Hynrei um treh sngap ïa ka jingpyni lem kita ki ’riewtymmen ïa u, bad u la wad jingmut na ki samla kiba la ïasan ïarangbah bad u, bad kiba ïadon bad u.
Te u la ong ha ki, “Kumno phi ai jingmut ba ngan jubab ïa une u paidbah uba kwah ba ngan pynsting ïa ka lyngkor kaba u kpa jong nga u la pynkit halor jong ki?”

Kita ki samla kiba la ïasan ïarangbah bad u ki la ong ha u, “Phin jubab kumne ïa kita ki paidbah kiba la ong ïa phi, ‘U kpa jong phi u la ai ïa ngi ka lyngkor ka bakhia, hynrei ma phi to pynsting noh na ka bynta jong ngi’; phin ong kumne ïa ki, ‘Ka ’tiduh jong nga ka kham myrdung ban ïa ka syngkai u kpa jong nga.

Te kumta, lada u kpa jong nga u la pynkit ha phi ka lyngkor ka bakhia, nga ngan nang kynton shuh ha ka lyngkor jong phi. U kpa jong nga u la sympat ïa phi da u thri, nga ngan sympat ïa phi da u shabuk.’ ”
Ha ka sngi ka balai u Jeroboam bad ki paidbah baroh ki la wan sha u Rehoboam, kumba u syiem u la ong, “Sa wan biang sha nga hadien lai sngi.”
U syiem u la ai ïa ki ka jubab ka bakhor, bad um shym pdiang ïa ka jingai jingmut ki ’riewtymmen.

U syiem Rehoboam u la jubab ïa ki kumba la ai buit ki samla, “U kpa jong nga u la ai ïa phi ka lyngkor ka bakhia, nga pat de ngan nang pyntam shuh shuh. U kpa jong nga u la sympat ïa phi da u thri, nga ngan sa sympat ïa phi da u shabuk.”
Kumta u syiem um shym shah shkor ïa ki paidbah. Dei u Blei Uba la pynjia ïa ka jingkylla ki kam; kumta la pyndep ïa ka ktien kaba u Trai U la kren da u Ahija nong Shilon ha u Jeroboam u khun u Nebat.

Haba ki Israel baroh ki la ïohi ba u syiem um shah shkor ïa ki, ki paidbah ki la jubab ïa u syiem, “Ngi don bynta aïu bad u Dabid? Ngim don bynta bad u khun u Jesse. Uwei pa uwei na phi sha la ïing jaiñ, ko Israel! Sa peit hi mynta ïa la ka jong ka ïing, ko Dabid.” Kumta ki Israel baroh ki la leit noh sha la ki ïing jaiñ.
Kumta u Rehoboam u la synshar tang halor ki paid Israel kiba shong ha ki shnong Juda.

Te u syiem Rehoboam u la phah ïa u Hadoram, u sordar halor ki kam khalasi, hynrei ki Israel ki la lynthem maw ïa u haban da ïap. U syiem Rehoboam hi u la pynkloi ban kiew halor ka kali, bad u la phet sha Jerusalem.
Kumta ka Israel ka la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka Ïing u Dabid haduh kane ka sngi.
Haba u Rehoboam u la poi ha Jerusalem u la lum lang ïa ki jait Juda bad Benjamin, shispah phraphew hajar ngut ki ’riewïaleh ki bakynsai, ban ïaleh thma ïa ki Israel, ban pynïoh biang ïa ka hima ha u.
Hynrei ka ktien u Trai ka la wan ha u Shemaïa u briew jong u Blei:
“Khie ïathuh ïa u Rehoboam u khun u Solomon syiem Juda, bad ïa ki Israel baroh kiba ha Juda bad Benjamin

ba u Trai U ong kumne, ‘Phim dei ban leit ïaleh thma ïa la ki hynmen ki para. Man la u rangbah, khie leit phai noh sha la ïing la ïing, namar Nga la pynjia ma Nga ïa kane kaei kaei.’ ” Kumta ki la shah shkor ïa ka ktien u Trai bad ki la leit phai noh, khlem da leit ïaleh ïa u Jeroboam.
U Rehoboam u la shong ha Jerusalem, bad u la pynkhlaiñ ïa ki shnong ha Juda.
U la tei ïa ka Bethlehem, ka Etam, ka Tekoa,
ka Beth-Zur ka Soko, ka Adullam,
ka Gath, ka Maresha, ka Ziph,
ka Adoraim, ka Lakhish, ka Aseka,
ka Zora, ka Aijalon bad ka Hebron; kine baroh ki shnong ba la pynkhlaiñ ha Juda bad ha Benjamin.
U la shna ki kut ki bakhlaiñ, u la buh ki rangbah pyrton ha ki, bad u la taïar ka jynbam, ka umphniang bad ka waiñ.
U la buh ruh ki stieh bad ki sum ha ki shnong baroh, bad u la pynkhlaiñ ïa ki haduh katta katta. Kumta u la synshar ïa ka Juda bad ka Benjamin.
Te ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi kiba don ha Israel baroh ki la wan phet sha u na ki jaka baroh ba ki la shong.
Ki Lebi ki la ieh noh ïa la ki ri raid bad ki ri kynti bad ki la wan noh sha Juda bad Jerusalem, namarba u Jeroboam bad ki khun jong u ki la beh noh ïa ki na ka kam shakri kum ki lyngdoh u Trai,
bad namarba u la thung la ki jong ki lyngdoh na ka bynta ki duwan halor lum, na ka bynta ki satir, bad na ka bynta ki masi khun ba shu thaw hi.
Kito ki jait Israel baroh kiba la angnud ban shakri ïa u Trai u Blei ki Israel, ki la bud ïa ki sha Jerusalem ban kñia ha u Trai u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki.
Ki la pynkhlaiñ bor ïa ka hima Juda, bad kumba lai snem u Rehoboam u khun u Solomon u la sngewshngaiñ, namar ha kito ki lai snem u la bud ïa ki nuksa u Dabid bad u Solomon.
U Rehoboam u la ïapoikha bad ka Mahalath ka khun u Jerimoth, u khun u Dabid bad ka Abihail, ka khun u Eliab u khun u Jesse.
Ki khun jong u na ka, u Jeush, u Shemaria, bad u Aham.
Hadien jong ka u la shim lok ïa ka Maaka ka khun u Absalom bad na ka u la ïoh ïa u Abija, u Attai, u Ziza bad u Shelomith.

U Rehoboam u la ieid kham palat ïa ka Maaka ka khun u Absalom ban ïa kiwei pat ki tnga bad ki tnga kliar jong u baroh (u la don khatphra ngut ki tnga bad hynriewphew ngut ki tnga kliar, bad u la ïoh arphew phra ngut ki khun shynrang bad hynriewphew ngut ki khun kynthei).
Te u Rehoboam u la thung rangbah duh ïa u Abija u khun ka Maaka napdeng shipara, namar u la mut ban pynlong syiem ïa u.
U la leh husiar haba u pynsaphret ïa ki katto katne ngut ki khun shynrang jong u sha ki shnong kut kylleng ki jylla. U la ai pahuh ka bam ka dih ïa ki, bad u la pynïoh ki tnga na ka bynta jong ki.
Haba u Rehoboam u la skhem ha ka bor syiem bad u la khlaiñ, u la lyndet ïa ka aiñ u Trai, ma u bad ki Israel baroh ruh lem bad u.
Ha ka snem ka basan ba u Rehoboam u long syiem, namarba u la lyndet ïa u Trai, u Shishak syiem Ijipt u la wan hiar thma ïa ka Jerusalem
da ki khat-ar hajar ki kali bad hynriewphew hajar ki shipai shongkulai. U paidbah ubym lah ñiew u la wan lang bad u na Ijipt – ki Libia, ki Sukkiim bad ki Ethiopia.
U la jop ïa ki shnong kut jong ka Juda bad u la wan poi haduh Jerusalem.

Te u Shemaïa nongïathuhlypa u la wan sha u Rehoboam bad ki rangbah Juda kiba la ïalang ha Jerusalem na ka daw u Shishak, bad u la ong ha ki, “U Trai U ong kumne, ‘Phi la lyndet ïa Nga, te Nga pat Nga la aiti ïa phi ha ka kti u Shishak.’ ”
Kumta ki rangbah Israel bad u syiem ki la pynrit ïa lade bad ki la ong, “U Trai U long u bahok.”

Haba u Trai U la ïohi ba ki la pynrit ïa lade, ka ktien u Trai ka la wan ha u Shemaïa, “Ki la pynrit ïa lade, te Ngan ym pynjot ïa ki; Ngan dang pyllait ïa ki katto katne bad Ngan ym theh lut ïa ka jingbitar jong Nga halor ka Jerusalem da ka kti u Shishak.
La katta ruh kin long ki shakri jong u ba kin dup sngewthuh kaei ka jingshakri ïa Nga bad kaei ka jingshakri ïa ki hima pyrthei.”

Kumta u Shishak syiem Ijipt u la wan hiar thma ïa ka Jerusalem. U la knieh ïa ki jynkynshew ka ïing u Trai bad jong ka ïing syiem; u la rah noh baroh phar. U la rah noh ruh ïa ki stieh ksiar kiba u Solomon u la thaw.
U syiem Rehoboam u la shna bujli da ki stieh rnong bad u la phah sumar ïa ki ha ki rangbah karod kiba ap ïa ka jynkhang jong ka ïing syiem.
Te kumta man ka sien ba u syiem u leit rung hapoh ka ïing u Trai, ki nongap karod ki rah bad ki wanlam biang ïa ki sha ïing karod.
Namarba u la pynrit ïa lade, ka jingbitar u Trai ka la phai noh na u, bad kam shym la pynjot thiaw ïa u.

Ki kam ki la ïaid bha ha Juda kumta u syiem Rehoboam u la pynskhem ïa lade ha Jerusalem bad u dang ïoh synshar. U Rehoboam u la don sawphew wei snem ka ryta haba u la sdang ban synshar bad u la synshar khathynñiew snem ha Jerusalem, ka nongbah kaba u Trai U la jied kyrpang napdeng ki jait Israel baroh ban buh ïa la ka kyrteng jong u hangta. Ka kmie jong u ka kyrteng ka Naama ka nong Ammon.
U la leh bymman, namarba um shym la buh jingmut ban wad ïa u Trai.
Te ïa ki kam u Rehoboam, naduh basdang haduh bakut, la thoh ha ki jynthoh kynmaw u Shemaïa nongïathuhlypa bad ha ki jong u Iddo u kunok. La don ki thma lynter tait hapdeng u Rehoboam bad u Jeroboam.
U Rehoboam u la ïohthiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid. U Abija u khun jong u u la synshar hadien jong u.
Ha ka snem ka bakhatphra jong u syiem Jeroboam, u Abija u la sdang ban synshar ha Juda.
U la synshar lai snem ha Jerusalem. Ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka Mikaïa ka khun u Uriel nong Gibea. Te la khih ka thma hapdeng u Abija bad u Jeroboam.

U Abija u la leit sha ka jingïaleh bad ka pyrton ki ’riewthma ki bashlur, sawspah hajar ngut ki ’rangdajied; u Jeroboam pat de u la pynkhreh ban ïaleh bad u da ki phraspah hajar ngut ki ’rangdajied, ki ’riewthma ki bakhlaiñ bor.
Te u Abija u la ïeng halor u lum Zemaraim uba don ha ri lum Ephraim, bad u la ong, “Ko Jeroboam, ko Israel baroh, to sngap ïa nga!
Phim tip mo ba u Trai u Blei ki Israel U la ai ïa ka hima Israel ha u Dabid bad ha ki khun jong u shi junom da ka jutang mluh?
Hynrei pynban u Jeroboam u khun u Nebat, u shakri u Solomon u khun u Dabid, u la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa la u kynrad.

Nangta pat katto katne ngut ki ’riewthala kibym larkam ei ei ki la ïalang bad u ban pyn-eh ïa u Rehoboam u khun u Solomon, haba u Rehoboam u dang khynnah bad um pat nang pyrkhat, kumta um shym lah ban ïaleh ïa ki.
Mynta pat phi mut ban ïaleh ïa ka hima u Trai kaba ha ka kti ki khun u Dabid, namarba phi ïabun paid bad phi don ïa ki masi ksiar kiba u Jeroboam u la thaw ba kin long ki blei jong phi.

Hato phim shym la beh noh ïa ki lyngdoh u Trai, ki khun u Aron, bad ïa ki Lebi, bad phi la thung da la ki jong ki lyngdoh kumba leh ki briew ha kiwei pat ki ri? Kat uba wan pynkyntang ïa lade da u ’silyngraw ne hynñiew tylli ki ’langshynrang hana u long lyngdoh sa ïa kita kibym dei blei satia.
Hynrei ngi te, u Trai U dei u Blei jong ngi bad ngim shym lyndet ïa U. Ngi don ki lyngdoh, ki khun u Aron kiba shakri ïa u Trai, bad sa ki Lebi ban ïarap kam ïa ki.

Kine ki tyrwa ha u Trai man ka step man ka janmiet ki jynkñia thang bad ka dhup iwbih, ki sei ïa u ’pu pyni halor ka miej kaba da ka ksiar banylla, bad ki sumar ïa ka jynpynïeng sharak ksiar ba ki sharak kin dup meh man ka janmiet. Ngi ngi dang rakhe ïa la ki deiti ha u Trai u Blei jong ngi, hynrei phi phi la lyndet ïa U.

To tip, u Blei U dei u Nongïalam rangbah jong ngi, bad ki lyngdoh jong U ki don ki turoi thma ban put ïa ka jingkhot sha ka thma pyrshah ïa phi. Ko khun rangbah ka Israel, hei! wat ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Trai, u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong phi; phin ym lah satia.”
U Jeroboam u la phah ap thap ban tawiar na shadien jong ki; kumta u la don ki shipai na shakhmat ki Juda bad ki nongap thap pat na shadien jong ki.
Haba ki Juda ki la peit bad ïohi ba ka thma ïa ki ka la long na shakhmat bad shadien, ki la pyrta ha u Trai bad ki lyngdoh ki la put ïa ki turoi.
Kumta ki Juda ki la kynkaw thma. Haba ki Juda ki la pyrta, u Blei U la pynher krad ïa u Jeroboam bad ïa ki Israel baroh hakhmat u Abija bad ki Juda.
Ki paid Israel ki la phet ïap hakhmat ki Juda, bad u Blei U la aiti ïa ki ha ka kti jong ki.
U Abija bad ki paid jong u ki la pynïap ïa ki haban da suwan khait, sanspah hajar ngut ki ’rangdajied ka Israel ki la kyllon ïap.
Kumta ïa ki paid Israel la pyndem ha kata ka por, bad ki paid Juda ki la jop, namarba ki la shaniah ha u Trai, u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki.

U Abija u la beh nadien ïa u Jeroboam. U la ïoh knieh ïa ki shnong jong u, ïa ka Bethel lem bad ki nongrit jong ka, ïa ka Jeshana lem bad ki nongrit jong ka, bad ïa ka Ephron lem bad ki nongrit jong ka.
U Jeroboam um shym ïoh bor shuh katba dang im u Abija. U Trai U la tangon ïa u, bad u la ïap.
Hynrei u Abija u la nangkhlaiñ bor. U la shim tnga khatsaw ngut bad u la ïoh arphew ar ngut ki khun shynrang bad khathynriew ngut ki khun kynthei.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Abija, ïa ka rukom im jong u bad ïa ki jingkren jong u, la thoh ha ka jingïathuh khana u Iddo nongïathuhlypa.
Kumta u Abija u la ïohthiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u bad ki la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid, bad u Asa u la synshar hadien jong u. Ha ki sngi jong u ka ri ka la suk la saiñ kumba shiphew snem.
U Asa u la leh tang ïa ka babha bad kaba pynsngewbha ïa u Trai u Blei jong u.
U la weng noh ïa ki duwan nongwei bad ïa ki duwan halor lum, u la pynpait ïa ki rishot bad u la pom pynpra ïa ki Asherim.
U la hukum ïa ki Juda ban wad ïa u Trai, u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki, bad ban rakhe ïa ka aiñ bad ka hukum.
U la pynduh na ki shnong Juda baroh ïa ki duwan halor lum bad ïa ka duwan thang dhup. Kumta ka hima ka la suk la saiñ hapoh jong u.
U la tei ïa ki shnong kut Juda, namar ka ri ka don ha ka jingsuk. Um shym don thma don ktien ha kito ki snem, namar ba u Trai U la ai jingsuk ïa u.

Te u la ong ha ki Juda, “Ïa ngin ïatei ïa kine ki shnong bad ngin ïaker tawiar ïa ki da ki kynroh bad ki kut, da ki khyrdop bad ki nar khang. Ka ri ka dang dei ka jong ngi, namar ngi la wad ïa u Trai u Blei jong ngi. Ngi la wad ïa U bad U la ai jingsuk ïa ngi na kylleng sawdong.” Kumta ki la tei bad ki la manbha.
U Asa u la don ki shipai laispah hajar ngut na Juda kiba rah stieh bad sum, sa arspah sanphew hajar pat na ki Benjamin kiba rah stieh bad kiba siat khnam. Ki la long baroh ki ’riewkhlaiñ ki bashlur.
U Zera nong Ethiopia u la wan tur pyrshah ïa ki da ki shipai shi milian ngut bad laispah tylli ki kali, bad u la wan haduh ha Maresha.
U Asa u la leit ban ïakynduh ïa u, bad ki la khreh ïaleh baroh arliang ha ka them Zephatha ha Maresha.

Te u Asa u la khot kyrpad ïa u Trai u Blei jong u, “A Trai, ym don kum ma Me ban ïarap hapdeng ki bakhlaiñ bor bad ki batlot. Ïarap ïa ngi ko Trai ko Blei jong ngi, namar ngi shaniah tang ha Me, bad ha ka kyrteng jong Me ngi la wan ïaleh ïa une u paid byllien. A Trai, Me long u Blei jong ngi, wat ai ba u briew un jop ïa Me.”
Kumta u Trai U la ai jingjop u Asa bad ki Juda halor ki Ethiopia, bad ki Ethiopia ki la phet krad.

U Asa bad ki paid kiba ïadon bad u ki la beh ïa ki haduh Gerar, bad ki Ethiopia ki la kyllon khlem lait-im wat uwei ruh, namar ki la shah pynlwet ha u Trai bad ki pyrton jong u. Ki pyrton Juda ki la ïoh knieh shikatdei bah ka bai kliarwait.
Ki la pom ïa ki shnong baroh sawdong ka Gerar, namar ka jingtieng burom ïa u Trai ka la ngat ha ki. Ki la lute ïa ki shnong baroh, namar ki la don shibun ka mar kliarwait.
Ki la pom ïa ki ïing jaiñ jong kiba don jynri, bad ki la rong noh shikatdei ki langbrot bad ki ut. Nangta ki la wan phai sha Jerusalem.
Te u Mynsiem jong u Blei U la hiar ha u Azaria khun u Oded.

Une u la leit ban ïashem ïa u Asa bad u la ong ha u, “To sngap ïa nga, ko Asa, bad phi baroh ki Juda bad ki Benjamin. U Trai U don ryngkat bad phi, katba phi ruh phi dang don ryngkat bad U. Lada phi wad ïa U, phin shem ïa U; lada phi lyndet ïa U, U ruh Un lyndet ïa phi.
La slem bah ka Israel kam don shuh ïa u Blei bashisha, kam don shuh u lyngdoh uba hikai, bad kam don aiñ shuh.
Hynrei haba ka jingjynjar ka lap ïa ki, bad ki phai sha u Trai, u Blei ka Israel bad ki wad ïa U, ki shem ïa U.
Ha kito ki por ym don jingsuk satia ïa uba leit ba wan, hynrei tang ka jingsngewtriem suda ïa ki trai shnong jong ki ri baroh.
La pynlwet lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki, kawei ka jait bynriew ka ïeng pyrshah ïa kawei pat, kawei ka shnong ïa kawei pat, namar u Blei U la pynshitom ïa ki da ki jingjynjar kiba har rukom.
Hynrei ma phi, to long u bashlur! Wat pyntlot ïa la ki kti, namar ïa ka jyntrei jong phi yn sa ai bainong.

Haba u Asa u la ïohsngew ïa kine ki ktien bad ïa ka jingïathuh lypa u Azaria u khun u Oded, u la sngewshngaiñ. U la bret noh ïa ki blei thaw ba-isaitmet na ri Juda bad Benjamin baroh bad na ki shnong kiba u la knieh ha ri lum Ephraim, bad u la maramot ïa ka duwan u Trai kaba don hakhmat ka batsha ka ïing u Trai.

U la lum lang ïa ki Juda, bad ki Benjamin, bad ïa kito kiba na Ephraim, na Manasse, bad na Simeon, kiba shongbasa bad ki, namar bun bah ki la wan phet sha u na Israel haba ki la ïohi ba u Trai u Blei U don ryngkat bad u.
Ki la ïalang ha Jerusalem ha u bnai u balai jong ka snem ka bakhatsan jong ka jingsynshar u Asa.
Ki la kñia ha u Trai ha kata ka sngi, na ki bai kliar-wait ba ki la wan rah, hynñiew spah tylli ki masidab bad hynñiew hajar tylli ki langbrot.
Ki la ïateh jutang ban wad ïa u Trai, u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki, da ka dohnud jong ki baroh bad da ka mynsiem jong ki baroh,
bad ba dei ban pynïap ïa uno uno ubym wad ïa u Trai, u Blei ki Israel, lada dei u samla ne u tymmen, u shynrang ne ka kynthei.
Ki la ïa kular ha u Trai da ka sur bajam, da ka jingrisa, da ki turoi bad da ki ronsing.

Baroh shi Juda ki la shadkmen ïa ka jingkular namar ki la kular da ka dohnud jong ki baroh. Ki la wad ïa u Trai da ka jingkwah jong ki baroh. U Trai U la don bad ki, bad U la ai jingsuk ïa ki kylleng sawdong.

U syiem Asa u la pynduh long syiem wat ïa la ka kmie, ka Maaka, namarba ka la don ïa ka dur Ashera ka ba-isaitmet. U Asa u la khet ïa ka dur jong ka, u la pynlwet ïa ka bad u la thang ïa ka ha wahduid Kidron.
Wat lada um shym la pynduh ïa ki duwan halor lum, ka dohnud u Asa ka la long ka bakhlem thohbria katba u dang im.
U la wan rah sha ka ïing u Blei ïa ki jynai kular niam jong u kpa jong u bad ïa ki jynai kular niam lajong, ïa ka rupa, ka ksiar bad ki khiew ki pliang ruh.
Te haduh ka snem kaba laiphewsan jong ka jingsynshar u Asa ym shym don thma shuh.
Ha ka snem ka balaiphew hynriew jong ka jingsynshar u Asa, u Baasha syiem Israel u la hiar thma ïa ka Juda, bad u la tei ïa ka Rama ban khang lad ïano ïano ban ïaleit ïawan bad u Asa syiem Juda.
Te u Asa u la shim ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar na ki jynkynshew ka ïing u Trai bad jong ka ïing syiem, bad u la phah ïa ki sha u Ben-Hadad syiem Siria, uba shong ha Damaskus u ong,

“To ïateh lok hapdeng jong nga bad jong phi, kumba la don hapdeng u kpa jong nga bad u kpa jong phi. Peit, nga phah sha phi ka rupa bad ka ksiar; phi to khie leit pdam noh ïa ka jingïateh jutang bad u Baasha syiem Israel, ba un dup kynriah noh na nga.”

Te u Ben-Hadad u la shah shkor ïa u syiem Asa, bad u la phah ïa la ki rangbah pyrton ban hiar thma ïa ki shnong Israel. Ki la jop ïa ka Ijon, ka Dan, ka Abel-Maim, bad ïa ki shnong lum jynbam jong ka Naphtali.
Haba u Baasha u la ïohsngew ïa kata, u la sangeh ban tei ïa ka Rama, bad u la phah keiñ noh ïa ka jyntrei.
Kumta u syiem Asa u la kem bikar ïa ki Juda baroh ban kit ïa ki maw bad ki dieng ba u Baasha u la pyntei ïa ka Rama, bad da ki u la tei pynskhem ïa ka Geba bad ka Mizpa.

Ha kata ka por u Hanani kunok u la wan sha u Asa syiem Juda, bad u la ong ha u, “Namarba phi la shaniah ha u syiem Siria bad phim shaniah shuh ha u Trai u Blei jong phi, ki pyrton u syiem Siria ki la lait na phi.

Ha ong hato ki Ethiopia bad ki Libia kim dei ki pyrton shipai ki bakhraw bad shikatdei bah ki kali bad ki nongshong kulai? Khat-ei u Trai U la ai du ïa ki ha ki kti jong phi namarba phi la shaniah ha U.
Ki khmat u Trai ki shat kylleng ka pyrthei baroh kawei, ban pyni ïa la ka bor na ka bynta kito kiba beit ka dohnud bad U. Phi la leh biej ha kane. Naduh mynta phin sa don ki thma.”
Hangta u Asa u la dom ïa u kunok bad u la khum ïa u na ki kjat hapoh byndi, namarba u la bitar ïa u shaphang kane. U Asa u la lehbeiñ ruh ïa la ki briew katto katne ngut ha kajuh ka por.
Ïa ki kam u Asa, naduh basdang haduh bakut, la thoh ha ka Kitab ki Syiem Juda bad Israel.

Ha ka snem ka balaiphew khyndai jong ka jingsynshar jong u, u Asa u la kem pang ha ki kjat, bad ka jingpang ka nangjur. Pynban la u pang katta, um shym wad jingïarap na u Trai, hynrei na ki nongpynkhiah.
U Asa u la ïohthiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u; u ïap ha ka snem ka basawphew wei jong ka jingsynshar jong u.

Ki la tep ïa u ha ka jyntep kaba u la tih hi na ka bynta ïa lade ha ka Nongbah u Dabid. Ki la pynthiah ïa u ha ka krong ba la siang da ki jait jyniwbih kiba har rukom, ba la pynkhreh da ka buit stad u nongshna jyniwbih. Bad ki la pynlong ka jingthang ka bakhraw shibun ban leh burom ïa u.
U khun u Asa, u Jehoshaphat, u la synshar hadien jong u. U la pynkhlaiñ ïa lade pyrshah ki Israel,
u la buh pyrton ha ki shnong kut baroh jong ka Juda, bad u la buh ki karod ha ri Juda bad ha ki shnong Ephraim kiba u Asa u kpa jong u u la ïoh dakhol.
U Trai U la don ryngkat bad u Jehoshaphat namarba u la ïaid ha ki lynti kiba u kpa jong u u la bud mynshuwa. Um shym wad satia ïa ki Baal,
hynrei u la wad ïa u Blei jong u kpa jong u, da kaba ïaid ha ki hukum jong U, ym dei kumba leh ki Israel.
Namarkata u Blei U la pynskhem ïa ka jingsynshar ha ka kti jong u. Ka Juda baroh kawei ka la wan ai khajna ha u Jehoshaphat, kumta u la ïoh shibun ka spah bad ka burom.
U la long u bashynrang ka dohnud ha ka jingshakri ïa u Trai, bad u la weng noh ïa ki duwan halor lum bad ïa ki Asherim na Juda.
Ha ka snem ka balai jong ka jingsynshar jong u u la phah ïa ki ’riewrangbah jong u, u Ben-Hail, u Obadia, u Zekharia, u Nethanel, bad u Mikaïa, ban hikai ha ki shnong Juda.

Bad ki la don kine ki Lebi, u Shemaïa, u Nethania, u Zebadia, u Asahel, u Shemiramoth, u Jehonathan, u Adonija, u Tobija bad u Tobadonija. Ryngkat bad kine ki Lebi, la don ki lyngdoh, u Elishama bad u Jehoram.
Haba ki hikai ha Juda, ki da don ïa ka kitab jong ka aiñ u Trai ryngkat bad ki. Ki la shang kylleng ki shnong Juda bad ki la hikai hapdeng ki paidbah.
Ka jingtieng burom ïa u Trai ka la ngat halor ki hima baroh jong ki ri kiba don sawdong ka Juda, bad kim shym nud ïaleh thma ïa u Jehoshaphat.

Don ki Philistia kiba la wan rah ha u Jehoshaphat ïa ki jynai sngewbha bad ka rupa kum ka khajna; ki Arab pat ki la wan rah ïa u hynñiew hajar hynñiewspah ki ’langbrot bad hynñiew hajar hynñiewspah ki blang.
Te u Jehoshaphat u la nangkhlaiñ nangkhlaiñ. U la tei ha Juda ki kut bad ki shnong lum jynbam,
kumta u la don ki jynkynshew kiba heh ha ki shnong Juda. U la don ki pyrton shipai da ki ’riewkhlaiñ ki bashlur, ha Jerusalem.
Kane ka long ka jingkheiñ ïa ki katkum ki ïing kur. Na ki Juda, ki rangbah jong ki shi hajar; u Adna rangbah pyrton u la don laispah hajar ki ’riewkhlaiñ ki bashlur;
uba marbud ïa u, u Jehohanan rangbah pyrton, u la don arspah phraphew hajar ngut;
uba hadien une pat dei u Amasia u khun u Zikhri, uba shu tyrwa trei-ei na ka bynta ka kam u Trai, u la don arspah hajar ki ’riewkhlaiñ ki bashlur.
Na ki Benjamin: u Eliada, u ’riewkhlaiñ u bashlur, u la don arspah hajar ngut kiba kieng ka ryntieh bad ka stieh;
uba marbud ïa u, u Jehosabad, u la don shispah phraphew hajar kiba kieng atiar thma.
Kine ki la don ha ka kam shakri ïa u syiem, nalor kito kiba u syiem u la lah buh ha ki shnong kut kylleng ka Juda.
U Jehoshaphat u la don ka spah bad ka burom kyrhai bad u la ïalok bad u Ahab da ka jingïapoikha poiman.

Katto katne snem hadien u la leit sha u Ahab ha Samaria. U Ahab u la pynïap shikatdei bah ki langbrot bad ki masidab na ka bynta jong u bad jong ki briew kiba bud ïa u, bad u la khroh ïa u ban leit hiar thma lang ïa ka Ramoth-Gilead.

U Ahab syiem Israel u la ong ha u Jehoshaphat syiem Juda, “Phin wan bad nga sha Ramoth-Gilead?” U la jubab ïa u, “Nga bad phi ngi long kawei, ki briew jong nga ruh bad ki briew jong phi. Ngin long ryngkat bad phi ha ka thma.”
Te u Jehoshaphat u la ong ha u syiem Israel, “Shuh ngin da wad jubab shuwa na u Trai.”

Kumta u syiem Israel u la lum lang ïa ki nongïathuhlypa, sawspah ngut ki la don, bad u la kylli ïa ki, “Hato ngin leit ïaleh thma ïa ka Ramoth-Gilead ne ngin ym leit?” Ki la ong, “Khie leit, u Blei Un sa aiti ïa ka ha ka kti u syiem.”
Hynrei u Jehoshaphat u la ong, “Hato ym don shuh sa uwei pat u nongïathuhlypa u Trai ba ngin wad jingtip?”

U syiem Israel u la ong ha u Jehoshaphat, “Dang don sa uwei pat ba ngin wad jingtip na u Trai, u Mikaïa khun u Imla, ïa uba nga isih namar um ju ïathuh lypa ei ei ka babha shaphang jong nga, hynrei tang ka basniew suda.” U Jehoshaphat u la ong, “Wat ong seh syiem kumta.”
Ynda kumta u syiem Israel u la khot uwei u rangbah bad u la ong, “Wan ïalam bak bak ïa u Mikaïa u khun u Imla.”

Te u syiem Israel bad u Jehoshaphat syiem Juda ha la ka riam syiem ki la shong ha la ki khet ki khet ha ka madan kyntem kaba hakhmat khyrdop ka Samaria, bad ki nongïathuhlypa baroh ki la ïathuh lypa hakhmat jong ki.
U Zedekia u khun u Khenaana u la thaw ki reng nar, bad u la ong, “U Trai U ong kumne, ‘Da kine phin sa tynrah ïa ki Siria haduh ba kin da ïap-duh.’ ”
Baroh ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïathuh lypa ruh kumta, bad ki la ong, “Khie sha Ramoth-Gilead bad phin sa jop. U Trai Un sa aiti ïa ka ha ki kti u syiem.”

Te u nongrah khubor u la leit khot ïa u Mikaïa u la ong ha u, “Peit mynta, ki nongïathuhlypa baroh lang ki la ai ka jubab ka babha ïa u syiem. Phi ruh to ïahap jingmut lang bad ki, bad to kren ïa ka babha.”
Hynrei u Mikaïa u la jubab, “Kumba u Trai U im, ngan kren ïa kata kaba u Blei jong nga U ong.”

Te haba u la wan sha u syiem, une u la kylli ïa u, “Ko Mikaïa, hato ngin leit ïaleh thma ïa ka Ramoth-Gilead, ne ngin pep noh?” U la phai ktien, “Khie leit bad phin sa jop. Ïa ki yn sa aiti ha ka kti jong phi.”
Hynrei u syiem u la ong ha u, “Sa katno sien keiñ ngan pynkular ïa phi ba phin ym ïathuh ei ei ha nga, hynrei tang ïa ka jingshisha ha ka kyrteng u Trai?”

Hangta u la ong, “Nga la ïohi ba ki Israel baroh ki ïasaphret halor ki lum kum ki langbrot kiba khlem nongsharai, bad u Trai U la ong, ‘Kine kim don kynrad, ieh kin leit phai noh sha la ïing la ïing ha ka jingsuk.’ ”
Kumta u syiem Israel u la ong ha u Jehoshaphat, “Ngam shym la ïathuh ïa phi ba une un ym ïathuh lypa ei ei ka babha shaphang jong nga, hynrei tang ïa ka basniew?”
U Mikaïa u la ong, “Namarkata to sngap ïa ka ktien u Trai: Nga la ïohi ïa u Trai ba U shong ha ka khet jong U, bad ki paidbah baroh jong ka bneng ki ïaïeng sha kamon bad sha kadiang.
U Trai U la ong, ‘Uei keiñ uban khroh ïa u Ahab syiem Israel ba un ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth-Gilead bad ba un kyllon hangta? Uwei u ong da kumne, uwei pat u ong da kumtai.
Te uwei u mynsiem u la wan bad u la ïeng hakhmat u Trai, u ong, ‘Ngan leit khroh ma nga ïa u.’ U Trai U la kylli ïa u, ‘Da kano ka buit?’
Uta u la ong, ‘Ngan leit long u mynsiem lamler ha ka shyntur jong ki nongïathuhlypa baroh.’ Te u Trai U la ong, ‘Phi dei ban riam ïa u, bad phin sa lah. Khie leit bad sa leh kumta.’
Hakhmih, namarkata, u Trai U la buh u mynsiem lamler ha ka shyntur kine ki nongïathuhlypa jong phi. U Trai U la rai ïa ka basniew pyrshah ïa phi.
Te u Zedekia u khun u Khenaana u la wan hajan bad u la thab ïa u Mikaïa na ka ngab, u ong, “Da kano ka lynti u mynsiem u Trai u la ïaid haba u mih na nga ban leit kren ha me?”
U Mikaïa u la jubab, “Men sa ïohi ha kata ka sngi ba men leit rieh ïa lade ha ka kamra ka bashapoh.”
Te u syiem Israel u la ong, “Kem ïa u Mikaïa, bad ïalam ïa u sha u Amon, u lat ka shnong, bad sha u Joash, u khun u syiem,
bad sa ïathuh, ‘U syiem u ong kumne: Set ïa une u briew ha byndi, bad ai bam ïa u jalia jalait tang da u kpu bad ka um, haduh ba ngan da wan phai ha ka basuk.’ ”
U Mikaïa u la ong, “Lada phi wan phai shisha ha ka basuk, u Trai Um shym kren da nga, sngew phi ki paidbah baroh.”
Kumta u syiem Israel bad u Jehoshaphat syiem Juda ki la leit hiar thma ïa ka Ramoth-Gilead.

U syiem Israel u la ong ha u Jehoshaphat, “Ngan riam pynpher ïa lade haba nga leit sha ka jingïaleh, hynrei ma phi kup la ki jaiñ syiem.” Te u syiem Israel u la riam pynpher ïa lade, bad ki la leit sha ka thma.
U syiem Siria u la hukum ïa ki rangbah pyrton kali, “Wat ïaleh ïa ki barit ne ki bakhraw, hynrei tang ïa u syiem Israel.”

Ka la jia ba haba ki rangbah jong ki pyrton kali ki la ïohi ïa u Jehoshaphat, ki la ïa-ong, “Utai u syiem Israel.” Kumta ki la phai ban ïaleh ïa u. U Jehoshaphat u la lynñiar bad u Trai U la ïarap ïa u. U Blei U la pynkynran noh ïa ki na u,
namar haba ki rangbah pyrton kali ki la ïohi ba um dei u syiem Israel, kim beh shuh ïa u.

Hynrei uwei u briew u la wiat antad ïa la ka ryntieh bad la dei ïa u syiem Israel namar jingbteng ka jynphong shadem, bad kumta u la ong ha u kariwan jong u, “Pynphai ïa ka kali, bad kit noh bak ïa nga na ka thma, namar nga la mynsaw.”
Ka thma ka la nangjur ha kata ka sngi, bad u syiem Israel u la shan ïa lade ha ka kali da kaba phai khmat sha ki Siria haduh ynda janmiet. U la ïap haba sep ka sngi.
U Jehoshaphat syiem Juda u la wan phai suk sha la ïing ha Jerusalem.

Hynrei u Jehu u khun u Hanani kunok u la leit ïakynduh ïa u bad u la ong ha u syiem Jehoshaphat, “Dei mo seh ban ïarap ïa ki ’riewbymman bad ban ieid ïa kito kiba isih ïa u Trai? Namar kane ka daw, ka jingbitar u Trai ka la mih pyrshah ïa phi.
La kumta ruh la shem katto katne ka jingbha ha phi, namar phi la pynduh ïa ki Ashera ha ka ri, bad phi la rai jingmut ban wad ïa u Blei.
U Jehoshaphat u la shong ha Jerusalem bad u la leit jngoh ïa la ki khun ki hajar naduh Beersheba haduh ri lum Ephraim, bad u la wan lam pat ïa ki sha u Trai, u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki.
U la thung ki nongbishar ha ka ri, uwei man la ka shnong Juda ba la ker kynroh,
bad u la ong ha ki nongbishar, “Da pyrkhat ïa kaba phi leh, namar phi bishar ym na ka bynta u briew hynrei na ka bynta u Trai Uba don bad phi ha ka jingbishar.
Te kumta, to ka jingtieng burom ïa u Trai kan don ha phi. To da sumar ïa kata kaba phi leh namar bad u Trai u Blei jong ngi ym don jingleh bymhok ne jingshah shiliang, ne jingbamsap.”

Nalor kata u Jehoshaphat u la thung ha Jerusalem katto katne ngut ki Lebi, ki lyngdoh bad ki rangbah ïingkur Israel ban bishar kam na ka bynta u Trai bad ban rai ïa ki kam ïakajia. Kine ki la shong ha Jerusalem.
Te u la hukum ïa ki, “Phi dei ban leh da ka jingtieng burom ïa u Trai, da ka jingshisha, bad da ka dohnud baroh.

Haba kano kano ka jingïakajia ka wan sha phi na ki kur ki jait jong phi kiba shong ha la ki shnong, lada shaphang ka jingïapynmynsaw snam ne ka jingpynkheiñ ïa ka aiñ, ïa ki hukum, ïa ki aiñ synshar ne ïa ki riti aiñ, phin maham ïa ki ba kin ym leh pap hakhmat u Trai, khnang ba ka jingbitar kan ym wan hiar halor jong phi bad jong ki kur ki jait jong phi. Lada phi leh kumne, phin ym kit pap ei ei.

U Amaria lyngdoh rangbah u long halor jong phi ha ki kam baroh jong u Trai; u Zebadia u khun u Ishmael, u lat na ka ïingkur Juda u dei ha ki kam baroh kiba ïadei bad u syiem; ki Lebi pat kin shakri kum ki nongkitkam jong phi. To leh shlur, bad to u Trai Un don ryngkat bad kito kiba ïaid beit!”
Hadien kane ki Moab bad ki Ammon, ryngkat bad ki Meon katto katne na ki ki la wan hiar thma ïa u Jehoshaphat.
Te la don kiba wan ïathuh ïa u Jehoshaphat, “U paidbah paidsan u wan hiar thma na Edom, na shalyndet ka duriaw, hakhmih ki don ha Hasason-Tamar” (kata ka mut, En-Gedi).
Te u Jehoshaphat u la sheptieng her, u la leit wad jingtip na u Trai, bad u la pynbna ba yn don jingshah jynit ha ri Juda baroh kawei.
Ki Juda baroh ki la pynlong ka jingïakynduh ban wad jingïarap na u Trai. Ki la wan na ki shnong baroh jong ka Juda ban wad ïa u Trai.
U Jehoshaphat u la ïeng ha kata ka jingïakynduh jong ka Juda bad ka Jerusalem hakhmat ka phyllaw ka bathymmai jong ka ïing u Trai.

U la ong, “A Trai, u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ngi, hato Mem long u Blei, Uba ha bneng? Ym dei ma Me? Uba synshar halor ki hima baroh jong ki jait bynriew? Ha ka kti jong Me don ka bor bad ka jingkhlaiñ, bad ym don uba lah ban ïeng pyn-eh ïa Me.
Ym dei ma Me, ko Blei jong ngi, Uba la beh ïa ki trai shnong kane ka ri hakhmat ki paid jong Me ki Israel, ban ai ïa ka junom ha ki khun ki kti u Abraham u lok jong Me?
Kumta ki la shong ha ka, bad ki la tei ha ka jaka kyntang ban ai burom ïa Me, da kaba ong,

‘Lada ka jingjynjar ka wan halor jong ngi da ka thma ban pynshitom ïa ngi, ne ka khlam, ne ka ’nemsniew, ngin ïeng hakhmat kane ka ïing bad hakhmat jong Me, namarba ka kyrteng jong Me ka don ha kane ka ïing; lada ngin lynñiar sha Me ha ka jingkordit, Men sngap bad Men pynim.’
Te mynta ki briew na Ammon, na Moab, bad na Lum Seir ïa kiba Mem shym la shah ba ki Israel kin hiar thma mynba ki la wan na ri Ijipt, hynrei ki la ïaid lait khlem da pynjot ïa ki—
ha peit, kumno kine mynta ki siew kylliang ïa ngi da kaba wan ban beh noh ïa ngi na ka ri kynti jong Me kaba Me la ai bynta ha ngi.
A Blei jong ngi, hato Men ym tian bishar ïa ki? Naba ngim don bor ban ïeng ïaleh ïa u paid katne katne uba wan tur pyrshah ïa ngi. Ngim tip satia kumno ban leh, hynrei ngi phai tang sha Me.”
Ha kata ka por baroh ki rangbah Juda, ryngkat bad ki khun ki kti bad ki tnga jong ki, ki la ïeng hakhmat u Trai.
Te u Mynsiem u Trai u la hiar halor u Jahasiel u khun u Zekharia, u khun u Benaïa, u khun u Jeïel, u khun u Mattania, u Lebi na ki khun u Asaph, hapdeng kata ka jingïakynduh,

bad u la ong, “To shah shkor, phi ki Juda baroh, phi kiba shong ha Jerusalem, bad phi ko syiem Jehoshaphat, naba u Trai U ong kumne ha phi: ‘To wat sheptieng, to wat khaw-eit ïa une u paid u babun namar ka thma kam dei ka jong phi hynrei ka jong u Blei.
Lashai khie leit tur pyrshah ïa ki. Kin wan kiew na u thiep Ziz; phin lap ïa ki ha trai ka them, sha mihngi ka ri kynjah Jeruwel.

Phin ym donkam ïaleh ha kane ka thma; to shu pynbeit jaka, ïeng skhem, bad peit ïa ka jingjop u Trai na ka bynta jong phi, ko Juda, ko Jerusalem. Wat sheptieng, wat khaw-eit, lashai khie leit tur pyrshah ïa ki, bad u Trai Un don ryngkat bad phi.”
Nangta u Jehoshaphat u la dem ngon sha khyndew, bad ki Juda baroh bad ki nong Jerusalem ki la dem hakhmat u Trai, bad ki la mane ïa U.
Ki Lebi, kiba na ki ïingkur Kohath bad Kora, ki la ïeng ban ïaroh ïa u Trai u Blei ka Israel, da ka sur ka bajam.

Ki la khie dang step phyrngab bad ki la leit sha ka ri kynjah Tekoa. Katba ki dang leit, u Jehoshaphat u la ïeng bad u la ong, “To sngap ïa nga, ko Juda bad phi kiba shong ha Jerusalem! To shaniah ha u Trai u Blei jong phi, bad phin sa sngewshngaiñ; to shaniah ha ki nongïathuhlypa jong phi bad phin sa jop.”

Te haba u la ïapyrkhat lang bad ki paidbah, u la thung ki briew kiba dei ban rwai ha u Trai bad ban ïaroh ïa U da ki jaiñphong ki bakhuid, katba ki nangïaid hakhmat ki pyrton shipai, da kaba ong, “To ainguh ïa u Trai, naba ka jingieid sbun jong U ka ïaineh junom.”
Haba ki la sdang ban rwai ïaroh, u Trai U la phah ban ap thap ïa ki Ammon, ïa ki Moab bad ïa kiba na lum Seir, kiba la wan tur pyrshah ki Juda, kumta ki la jop ïa ki.
Ki Ammon bad ki Moab ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa kiba na lum Seir bad ki la pynïap ïa ki baroh phoiñ, bad ynda ki la pynduh ïa ki nong Seir, ki la ïapynïap sa para ma ki.
Haba ki Juda ki la wan sha ka kut ap phira kaba ha ri kynjah, ki la peit shaba don uta u paidbah byllien. Waw, la don sa tang ki met ïap kiba thiah ha khyndew, khlem lait wat uwei.

Haba u Jehoshaphat bad ki paid jong u ki la wan ban shim ïa ka mar kliarwait na ki, ki la lap shikatdei bah ki jynri, ki tiar ki tar, ki jaiñphong, bad kiei kiei ki bakordor. Ki la shim-ei ïa lade haduh ba kim lah kit shuh. Lai sngi kynthih ki la kit sa kit ïa ka mar kliarwait namarba ka bun haduh katta katta.
Ha ka sngi ka basaw ki la ïakynduh lang ha them Beraka ban kyrkhu ïa u Trai hangta, bad kumta ïa kata ka jaka la khot ka Them ka Jingkyrkhu haduh mynta mynne.
Te baroh ki paid Juda bad Jerusalem ki la wan phai hapoh ka jingïalam u Jehoshaphat sha Jerusalem, ki risa leh kmen namar u Trai U la ai jingjop ïa ki nongshun jong ki.
Ki la wan sha Jerusalem sha ka ïing u Trai, bad ki duitara, ki marynthing bad ki turoi.
Ka jingsngewshyrkhei ïa u Blei ka la ngat ha ki hima baroh jong ki ri marjan, ki tang shu ïohsngew ba u Trai U la ïaleh ïa ki nongshun ki Israel.
Kumta ka hima u Jehoshaphat ka la suk la saiñ, namar u Blei jong u U la ai ïa u ka jingjai jai baroh sawdong.

Kumta u Jehoshaphat u la synshar halor ka ri Juda. U la don laiphewsan snem ka ryta mynba u la sdang ban synshar bad u la synshar arphewsan snem ha Jerusalem. Ka kmie jong u ka kyrteng ka Asuba, ka khun u Shilhi.
U la bud ïa ki dienjat u Asa u kpa jong u bad um shym phai kynriang na ki; u la leh ïa ka badei hakhmat u Trai.
La kumta ruh, ïa ki duwan halor lum ym pat shym weng noh; ki paidbah kim pat pynshong jingmut ha u Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Jehoshaphat, naduh ba sdang haduh bakut, lah ban shem ha ki jynthoh kynmaw u Jehu u khun u Hanani, ïa kiba la buh ha ka Kitab ki Syiem Israel.
Hadien kane u Jehoshaphat syiem Juda u la ïateh lok bad u Ahazia syiem Israel, uba la leh bymman.
U la shna lieng ryngkat bad u ban leit sha Tarshish, bad ki la thaw ïa ki lieng ha Ezion-Geber.

Te u Elieser, u khun u Dodabahu uba na Maresha, u la ïathuh lypa pyrshah ïa u Jehoshaphat, u ong, “Namarba phi ïateh lok bad u Ahazia, u Trai Un sa pynjot ïa kata kaba phi la leh.” Shisha kita ki lieng ki la pait bad kim shym lah ban leit sha Tarshish.
U Jehoshaphat u la ïohthiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad la tep ïa u bad ki ha ka Nongbah u Dabid. U Jehoram u khun jong u u la mihbteng ïa u.
Ki hynmen para jong u, ki khun u Jehoshaphat, ki la long u Azaria, u Jehiel, u Zekharia, u Azariahu, u Mikhael, bad u Shephatia; kine baroh ki la long ki khun u Jehoshaphat syiem Juda.

U kpa jong ki u la ai ïa ki shibun ki jynai sngewbha, kiba da ka rupa, ka ksiar, bad ki kynja mar ki bakordor, lem bad ki shnong kut ha Juda, hynrei u la ai ïa ka jinglong syiem ha u Jehoram, namarba u dei u khun phrangsngi.
U Jehoram, u tang shu sngewskhem hadien ba u la ïoh ïa ka khet u kpa jong u, u la pynïap ïa ki para lajong da ka waitlam, wat ïa ki bakhraw batri ka Israel ruh katto katne ngut.
U Jehoram u la don laiphew-ar snem ka ryta mynba u la long syiem, bad u la synshar phra snem ha Jerusalem.
U la bud ïa ka rukom im ki syiem Israel, kumba la im ka ïing ka sem u Ahab, namarba ka tnga jong u ka dei ka khun u Ahab. Te u la leh bymman hakhmat u Trai.
La katta ruh u Trai ym shym pynduh ïa ka Ïing u Dabid, namar ka jutang kaba U la ïateh bad u Dabid, bad namarba U la kular ban ai u nongmihbteng ha u bad ha ki khun ki kti jong u junom.
Ha ki sngi jong u, ka Edom ka la ïeng pyrshah ban lait na ka jingsynshar ki Juda, bad ka la thung la u jong u syiem.
Kumta u Jehoram u la leit bad la ki rangbah pyrton bad ki kali jong u baroh sha lyndet pud, bad ha ka por miet u la tur lyngba ki Edom kiba la ker tawiar ïa u bad ïa ki rangbah pyrton kali.

Hynrei ki Edom ki la lait da ka jingïaleh na ka jingsynshar ki Juda haduh kane ka sngi. Ha kajuh ka por ka Libna ruh ka la ïeng pyrshah ban lait na ka jingsynshar jong u, namarba u la lyndet ïa u Trai, u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong u.
Nalor kata u la thaw sa ki duwan lum ha ri lum Juda, u la pynngop ïa kiba shong ha Jerusalem ha ka jingmane blei thaw, bad ïa ki Juda ha ka jingleh bymman.

U la ïoh ka shithi na u Elija nongïathuhlypa kaba ong, “U Trai, u Blei jong u Dabid, u kpa tymmen jong phi, U ong kumne, ‘Namarba phim shym la bud ïa ki dienjat u Jehoshaphat u kpa jong phi, ne ïa ki rukom im u Asa syiem Juda,

hynrei phi la pyrthuh pynban ïa ki akor ki syiem Israel, phi la ïalam ïa ki Juda bad ïa ki nong Jerusalem ban kyrsum ha ka jingmane blei thaw kumba la leh ka ïing u Ahab kaba la pynngop ïa ki Israel ha ka jingmane blei thaw; nangta pat phi la pynïap ïa la ki para, kiba na ka ïing u kpa jong phi, ki briew kiba kham bha ban ïa phi:
U Trai Un sa phah ka khlam ka bakhraw halor ki briew jong phi, halor ki khun jong phi, halor ki tnga jong phi, bad halor kiei kiei kiba phi don.
Ma phi phin sa ïoh ka jingpang suh ka bajur ha ki snier, haduh ba hadien katto katne por, ki snier kin da mih shabar na ka daw jong ka jingpang.’ ”
Te u Trai U la pynkhih ïa ki Philistia bad ki Arab kiba shong marjan ki Ethiopia ban sni ïa u Jehoram.

Kine ki la hiar thma ïa ka Juda. Ki la rong noh ïa ki spah ki hajar u syiem katba ïoh, wat ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki tnga jong u, haduh ba ym sah khun shuh ïa u, lait tang u Jehoahas, u khun khatduh.
Hadien kane baroh, u Trai U la shoh ïa u da ka jingpang snier kabym lah koit shuh.

Ynda katto katne, hadien ar snem, ki snier jong u ki la mih shabar na ka daw jong ka jingpang, bad u la ïap ha ka lanot ka bakhraw. Ki briew jong u kim shym pynmeh ding burom ïa u, kumba ki la leh ïa ki kpa tymmen jong u.

U la don laiphew ar snem ka ryta haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar phra snem ha Jerusalem. U la khlad khlem don ba bynnud. Ki la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid, hynrei ym dei ha ki jyntep ki syiem.

Ki nong Jerusalem ki la thung syiem ïa u Ahazia, u khun khatduh jong u, ban mihbteng ïa u, namarba ka kynhun kaba la wan bad ki Arab ka la pynïap ïa ki khun rangbah jong u baroh phar. Kumta u Ahazia u khun u Jehoram syiem Juda u la long syiem.
U Ahazia u la don sawphew ar snem ka ryta haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar shi snem ha Jerusalem. Ka kmie jong u ka kyrteng ka Athalia, ka khun ksiew u Omri.
U la bud ïa ka rukom im ka ïing u Ahab, namar ka kmie jong u ka pyni buit ïa u ban leh bymman.
U la leh bymman hakhmat u Trai, kumba la leh kiba ha ïing ha sem u Ahab, namar hadien ka jingïap u kpa jong u dei ma ki kiba pyni buit ïa u haduh ba un da jot.
Da kaba bud ïa ka jingpyni buit jong ki u la leit ryngkat bad u Joram, u khun u Ahab syiem Israel, ban ïaleh thma ïa u Hazael syiem Siria ha Ramoth-Gilead. Ki Siria ki la ïoh pynmynsaw ïa u Joram,

bad u la wan phai sha Jezreel ban phah sumar ïa ki jynmong ba u la ïoh ha Rama, haba ïaleh thma ïa u Hazael syiem Siria. Te u Ahazia khun u Jehoram syiem Juda u la leit sha Jezreel ban peit ïa u Joram khun u Ahab namarba u pang.

Hynrei u Blei U la pynïaid ba u Ahazia u dei ban jot namarba u la leit peit ïa u Joram. Shisha haba u la poi hangta u la leit ryngkat bad u Joram ban ïakynduh ïa u Jehu u khun u Nimshi, ïa uba u Trai U la pynsleh ban pynduh ïa ka ïing ka sem u Ahab.

Katba u Jehu u dang pyndep ïa ka rai-bishar pyrshah ka ïing ka sem u Ahab, u la ïakynduh ïa ki ’riewheh ’riewhaiñ ka Juda bad ïa ki khun jong ki para u Ahazia, kiba ïabud ïa u Ahazia, bad u la pynïap ïa ki.

Nangta u la wad sa ïa u Ahazia, bad la ïoh kem ïa u katba u dangrieh ha Samaria. Ïa u la wan ïalam sha u Jehu bad la pynïap. Ki la tep ïa u, hana ba “U dei u khun ksiew u Jehoshaphat uba la wad ïa u Trai da ka dohnud jong u baroh.” Kumta ka ïing u Ahazia kam don shuh u briew uba lah ban synshar ïa ka hima.
Ka la jia ba haba ka Athalia ka kmie u Ahazia ka la ïohi ba u khun jong ka u la ïap, ka la leit ban pynïap ïa ki khun syiem baroh jong ka ïing Juda.

Hynrei ka Jehosheba ka khun u syiem, ka la shim buhrieh ïa u Jehoash u khun u Ahazia napdeng ki khun syiem ba la mang ban pynïap, bad ka la buh ïa u bad ka nongsumar ha kamra thiah. Ha kane ka rukom ka Jehosheba, kaba long ka khun u syiem Jehoram, shipara bad u Ahazia, bad ka tnga u lyngdoh Jehoïada, ka la buhrieh ïa u na ka Athalia, kumta kam shym ïoh pynïap ïa u.
U la sah bad ki hynriew snem, ba shu pynrieh ha ïing u Blei, katba ka Athalia ka dang synshar halor ka ri.

Ha ka snem ka bahynñiew u Jehoïada u la leh shlur, bad u la ïasynjuk bad ki rangbah pyrton jong ki shispah, u Azaria u khun u Jeroham, bad u Ishmael u khun u Jehohanan, bad u Azaria u khun u Obed, bad u Maaseïa u khun u Adaïa, bad u Elishaphat u khun u Zikhri.
Kine ki la leit kylleng ka Juda, bad ki la khot lang ïa ki Lebi na ki shnong Juda baroh bad ïa ki rangbah jong ki ïingkur Israel, nangta ki la wan sha Jerusalem.

Ka jingïakynduh baroh kawei ka la ïateh jutang bad u syiem ha ka ïing u Blei. Te u Jehoïada u la ong ha ki, “Une u khun u syiem ! Une u dei ban synshar, kumba u Trai U la kren shaphang ki khun u Dabid.
Phin ïaleh kumne: napdeng jong phi ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi kiba don ka kam shakri ha ka sabath, shibynta na ki laibynta kin long nongap khyrdop,
sa shibynta na ki laibynta kin don ha ïing syiem, bad sa shibynta na ki laibynta pat kin don ha ka Khyrdop Nongrim, katba u paidbah baroh un ïadon ha ki phyllaw ka ïing u Trai.

Ym dei ban rung mano mano ruh hapoh ïing u Trai lait tang ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi kiba shakri. Kine ki lah ban rung namar ki long ki bakhuid, hynrei u paidbah baroh u dei ban sumar ïa kaba u Trai U la buh aiñ.
Ki Lebi kin ker tawiar ïa u syiem, mar la ka tiar ha ka kti; kat ïa uba rung hapoh ka ïing dei ban pynïap. To don ryngkat bad u syiem kat shaba u leit.”

Ki Lebi bad ki paid Juda baroh ki la leh kumba hukum u Jehoïada lyngdoh. Uwei pa uwei u la wan ïalam la ki briew ki briew, kita kiba lait kam ha ka sngi sabath bad kita kiba donkam ha ka sabath namar u Jehoïada lyngdoh um shym pyllait kam shuh ïano ïano.
Te u Jehoïada lyngdoh u la sam ha ki rangbah pyrton ïa ki sum bad ki stieh, la rit la khraw, jong u syiem Dabid kiba don ha ka ïing u Blei.
