U la buh ïa ki paidbah baroh ban ap karod ïa u syiem, man la u briew bad la ka atiar ha ka kti, naduh shaphang kamon haduh shaphang kadiang jong ka ïing, baroh sawdong ka duwan bad ka ïing.

Nangta u la pynmih ïa u khun syiem, u la pynphong pansngiat ïa u bad u la ai ïa u ka kot aiñ. Ynda ki la thung syiem ïa u, u Jehoïada bad ki khun jong u ki la pynsleh ïa u, bad ki la pyrta, “To u syiem un im slem!”
Haba ka Athalia ka la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa jong ki briew kiba ïamareh bad ïaroh ïa u syiem, ka la leit sha ki paidbah hapoh ïing u Trai.

Ka la peit bad ka la ïohi ba don u syiem uba ïeng hajan u rishot jong u ha jynkhang, ba ki rangbah pyrton bad ki nongput turoi ki ïeng ha syndah u syiem, ba ki paidbah baroh jong ka ri ki ïarisa bad ki ïaput ïa ki turoi, bad ba ki nongrwai ki ïalam ïa ka jingleh burom da ki jyntem jong ki. Hangta ka Athalia ka la kad ïa la ki jaiñ bad ka la pyrta, “La shet kylla! La shet kylla!”

Te u Jehoïada lyngdoh u la pynmih ïa ki rangbah pyrton kiba u la thung halor ki pyrton shipai, u ong artat ïa ki, “Sei ïa ka shabar ka ïing. Kat uba bud ïa ka, pynïap da ka waitlam.” Bad u la pynbud, “Wat pynïap ïa ka hapoh ïing u Trai.”
Kumta ki la kem ïa ka, bad haba ki la poi sha tyngkong jong ka Khyrdop Kulai kaba ha ïing syiem, ki la pynïap ïa ka hangta.
Te u Jehoïada u la ïateh ka jutang hapdeng jong u hi, bad ki paidbah, bad jong u syiem, ba ki dei ban long ki briew u Trai.

Kumta ki paidbah baroh ki la leit sha ïing u Baal bad ki la pyntwa ïa ka. Ki la pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki duwan bad ki dur jong u, nangta ki la pynïap ïa u Mattan u lyngdoh u Baal hakhmat ki duwan.

U Jehoïada u la buh ki nongap phira ïa ka ïing u Trai hapoh ka jingpynïaid ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi. Dei ha ki ba u Dabid u la buh ban peit ïa ka ïing u Trai ban tyrwa jynkñia thang ha u Trai, kumba la thoh ha ka aiñ u Moses, da kaba kmen bad da kaba rwai kumba la pynbeit u Dabid.
U la buh sa ki nongap ha ki khyrdop ka ïing u Trai, khnang ba u kynja bymkhuid um dei ban rung.

U la shim ïa ki rangbah pyrton, ïa ki bakhraw batri, ïa ki lat jong ki paidbah bad ïa ki paidbah baroh jong ka ri, bad kine ki la ïalam ïa u syiem na ïing u Trai sha ïing syiem lyngba ka khyrdop kaba shaneng. Hangta ki la pynshong ïa u syiem halor ka khet syiem.
Kumta ki paidbah baroh ki la ïakmen, bad ka shnong ka thaw ka la suk kynjai, ynda la pynïap da ka waitlam ïa ka Athalia.
U Jehoash u la don hynñiew snem ka ryta haba u sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar sawphew snem ha Jerusalem. Ka kmie jong u ka kyrteng ka Zibia kaba na Beersheba.
U Jehoash u la leh ka badei hakhmat u Trai katba dang im u lyngdoh Jehoïada.
U Jehoïada u la pynïoh ar ngut ki tnga na ka bynta jong u, bad u la ïoh ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei.
Hadien kane u Jehoash u la rai ban shna pynbha ïa ka ïing u Trai.

U la lum lang ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi, bad u la ong ha ki, “Khie leit sha ki shnong Juda, bad lum peisa na ki Israel baroh ban maramot ïa ka ïing u Blei jong phi man ka snem. Peit ba phin leh kloi keiñ ïa kane ka kam.” Hynrei ki Lebi kim leh kloi satia.

Kumta u syiem u la khot ïa u Jehoïada uba long rangbah, bad u la ong ha u, “Balei keiñ ba phim bán bor ïa ki Lebi ban wan rah na Juda bad Jerusalem ïa ka synñiang khrong ba u Moses, u shakri u Trai, u la buh ha u paid Israel na ka bynta ka ïingjaiñ jong ka sakhi?”
Naba ki khun ka Athalia, kata ka kynthei dakaid, ki la pynjot ïa ka ïing u Blei bad ki la pyndonkam ruh ïa kiei kiei ki bakyntang jong ka ïing u Trai na ka bynta ki Baal.
Kumba la hukum u syiem, ki la shna kawei ka synduk bad ki la buh ïa ka shabar ka khyrdop ka ïing u Trai.
La pynbna kylleng ka Juda bad ka Jerusalem ban wan rah na ka bynta u Trai ïa u synñiang khrong ba u Moses u shakri u Blei u la buh ha ki Israel ha ri kynjah.
Baroh ki bakhraw batri bad ki paidbah ki la sngewkmen, bad ki la wan rah ïa la u synñiang khrong. Ki la thep ïa u hapoh ka synduk haduh ba ki la siew dep.

Te man ka sien ba ki Lebi ki wan rah ïa ka synduk sha ki rangbah syiem haba ki ïohi ba don peisa shibun ha ka, u nongthoh jong u syiem bad u rangbah jong u lyngdoh rangbah ki wan ban pynthylli ïa ka, ki rah noh ïa ka, bad ki sa pynphai biang ïa ka sha la ka jaka. Ki la leh kumne man la ka sngi, bad ki la lum shikatdei bah u synñiang u bynhei.

U syiem bad u Jehoïada ki la ai ïa u ha ki briew kiba dei ban pynïaid ïa ka kam jong ka ïing u Trai. Kine ki la wer ki misteri maw bad ki misteri dieng ban maramot ïa ka ïing u Trai, bad ki nongtrei nar bad ki nongtrei rnong ban shna pynbha ïa ka ïing u Trai.
Kumta kine ki nongtrei ki la trei thait thait, bad ka jingmaramot ka la ïaid shaphrang. Ki la shna pynbha ïa ka ïing u Blei haduh ba kan da biang bha bad ki la pynskhem de artat ïa ka.

Ynda ki la dep, ki la wan rah ïa ka peisa kaba sah sha u syiem bad u Jehoïada, bad da ka la thaw ki khiew ki pliang na ka bynta ki jingleh niam bad ki jingkñia thang ha ïing u Trai, nangta ki pliang dhup, bad ki khiew ksiar bad rupa. Te ki la tyrwa ki jynkñia thang ha ka ïing u Trai baroh shi lynter ki sngi u Jehoïada.
Te u Jehoïada, ynda u la tymmen bha ka ryta, u la ïap. U la don shispah laiphew snem ka ryta haba u la ïap.
Ki la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid hapdeng ki syiem, namarba u la shakri hok ïa u Blei bad ïa ka ïing jong U ha Israel.
Ka la jia ba hadien ka jingïap u Jehoïada ki bakhraw batri ka Juda ki la wan bad ki la nguh la dem ïa u syiem, bad u syiem u la wad jingmut pynban na ki.

Kine ki la lyndet ïa ka ïing u Trai, u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki, bad ki la mane ïa ki Asherim bad ïa ki blei thaw. Kumta ka jingbitar ka la hiar halor ka Juda bad ka Jerusalem na ka daw ka jingbymman jong ki.
La kumta ruh u la phah ïa ki nongïathuhlypa sha ki ba kin ïalam biang ïa ki sha u Trai. Kine ki la maham ïa ki, hynrei kim patiaw satia.

Te u Mynsiem u Blei u la wan ha u Zekharia u khun u lyngdoh Jehoïada, bad une u la ïeng hakhmat u paidbah, u la ong, “U Blei U ong kumne, ‘Balei keiñ phi pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum u Trai haduh ba khlem myntoi ei ei ïa phi? Namarba phi la lyndet ïa u Trai, ma U U la lyndet ïa phi.’ ”
Hynrei ki la ïasylla pynban pyrshah ïa u, bad da ka hukum u syiem ki la lynthem ïa u da ki maw ha ka phyllaw jong ka ïing u Trai.

Kumta u syiem Jehoash um shym kynmaw shuh ïa ka jinglehsbun kaba u Jehoïada, u kpa u Zekharia, u la leh ïa u, bad u la pynïap pynban ïa u khun jong u. Haba une u la jan ïap, u la ong, ‘To u Trai Un peit bad Un ai ka kput kylliang.”

Ha ka bakut kata ka snem ki paid pyrton Siria ki la hiar thma ïa u Jehoash. Ki la wan haduh Juda bad Jerusalem, bad ki la pynïap ïa ki bakhraw batri baroh jong ki paidbah, bad ki la phah ïa ka mar kliarwait jong ki baroh sha u syiem Damaskus.

Wat la tang khyndiat ngut ki pyrton Siria ki la wan, u Trai U la aiti ha ki kti jong ki ïa ka kynhun shipai ka baheh shibun-eh namarba ki la lyndet ïa u Trai u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki. Kumta ki la ai ïa u Jehoash ka jingpynshitom ka bahok.

Haba ki la leit noh, ynda ki la pynmynsaw jur ïa u, ki shakri jong u ki la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u na ka bynta ka snam u khun u Jehoïada lyngdoh, bad ki la pynïap ïa u ha jynthiah jong u. Kumta u la ïap. Ki la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid, hynrei ym dei hapdeng ki jyntep jong ki syiem.
Kito kiba la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u ki dei u Zabad u khun ka Shimeath ka nong Ammon, bad u Jehozabad u khun ka Shimrith ka nong Moab.

Ïa ki jingïathuh khana shaphang ki khun jong u, shaphang u synñiang u bynhei ba u la lum lang, shaphang ki jingkren blei pyrshah ïa u, bad shaphang ka jingtei biang ïa ka ïing u Blei, la thoh ha ka kot batai jong ka Kitab ki Syiem. Ïa u la mih bteng da u Amazia u khun jong u.
U Amazia u la don arphew san snem ka ryta haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar arphew khyndai snem ha Jerusalem. Ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka Jehoaddan ka nong Jerusalem.
U la leh ïa ka badei hakhmat u Trai , tang ba ym dei da ka dohnud kaba khlem thohbria.
U tang shu sngewkhlaiñ ka bor syiem ha la ki kti, u la pynïap ïa ki shakri jong u kiba la pynïap ïa u syiem, u kpa jong u.

Hynrei um shym pynïap ïa ki khun jong ki, namar u la leh kumba la thoh ha ka aiñ, ha ka kitab u Moses, ha kaba u Trai U la hukum: “Ïa ki kpa ym dei ban pynïap na ka bynta ki khun, ne ïa ki khun ym dei ban pynïap na ka bynta ki kpa; hynrei man la u briew un ïap na ka bynta ka kam bymman lajong hi.”

Te u Amazia u la lum lang ïa ki paid Juda—kata, baroh shi Juda bad baroh shi Benjamin—bad u la pynbeit ïa ki shi kur shi kur hapoh ki rangbah shi hajar bad ki rangbah shispah. U la shim jingkheiñ ïa kiba naduh arphew snem bad shaneng, bad u la shem ba ki don laispah hajar ki ’rangkynsai, ki batbit ban ïaleh thma, bad kiba nang ban pyndonkam ïa u sum bad ka stieh.
U la wer bylla sa shispah hajar ki ’riewkhlaiñ ki bashlur na Israel ha ka dor shispah talen ka rupa.
Hynrei la wan uwei u briew u Blei, bad u la ong ha u, “Ko syiem, wat shah ba ki pyrton Israel kin leit ryngkat bad phi, namarba u Trai Um don bad ki Israel, bad kine ki jait Ephraim.
Hynrei lada phi tharai ba da kane ka rukom phin sa khlaiñ na ka bynta ka thma, u Blei Un sa pynliem pynkyllon ïa phi hakhmat u nongshun, namar u Blei U don ka bor ban ïarap ne ban pynkyllon.”

U Amazia pat u la kylli ïa uta u briew u Blei, “Te ngin leh kumno ïa kito ki shispah talen kiba ngi la ai ha ki pyrton Israel?” Uta u briew u Blei u la phai ktien, “U Trai U lah ban ai ïa phi kham bun ban ïa kane.”
Kumta u Amazia u la phah noh ïa ki pyrton kiba la wan na Ephraim ba kin leit noh sha la ïing. Hynrei ki la bitar jur ïa ki Juda, bad ki la leit phai sha la ïing da ka jingingkhong kaba shyrkhei.
U Amazia u la ïalam ïa la ki paid da ka jingshlur, u la leit sha ka Them Mluh, bad u la pynïap shiphew hajar ngut ki nong Seir.
Ki pyrton Juda ki la kem koidi sa shiphew hajar ngut, nangta ki la ïalam ïa ki sha kliar u mawsiang bad ki la khynñiat ïa ki shapoh riat na kliar uta u mawsiang. Kumta ki la lwet lyngkhot lyngkhai.

Hynrei kito ki pyrton kiba u Amazia u la phah noh, ba um shah ïa ki ban leit lang bad u sha ka thma, ki la hiar thma ïa ki shnong Juda naduh Samaria haduh Beth-Horon, bad ki la pynïap lai hajar ngut ki briew, bad ki la rah noh ruh shibun ka mar kliarwait.
Ynda u Amazia u la wan phai na ka jingpynïap ïa ki Edom u la wan rah ïa ki blei jong ki nong Seir, u la pynlong ïa ki kum ki blei jong u, u la mane ïa ki, da kaba tyrwa jynkñia ha ki.

Namarkata u Trai U la bitar ïa u Amazia bad U la phah ïa u nongïathuhlypa ban ong ha u, “Balei sha phi leit wad ïa ki blei jong kata ka jait bynriew haba kim shym lah ban pyllait ïa la ki briew na ki kti jong phi?”

Hynrei katba u dang kren, u syiem u la kylli ïa u. “Hato ngi la pynlong myntri syiem ïa me mo seh? Lada mem kwah ban shah ïap ei, keiñ noh!” Kumta uta u nongïathulypa u la sangeh, hynrei u la pynbud, “Nga tip ba u Blei U la rai kut ban pynduh ïa me namarba me la leh ïa kane bad mem treh ban shah shkor ïa ka jingpynong lem jong nga.”
Te u Amazia syiem Juda, ynda u la ïoh buit u la phah briew sha u Joash u khun u Jehoahas, u khun u Jehu, u syiem Israel, u ong, “Ale, ngin ïatynjuh bor!”

U Joash syiem Israel u la phah ktien sha u Amazia syiem Juda, “U ’tiewshiah ha Lebanon u la phah ong kumne ïa u dieng kedar uba ha Lebanon ‘to ïapynpoikha ïa ka khun jong phi ha u khun jong nga’, te uwei u mrad khlaw uba na Lebanon u la ïaid najan bad u la kyrdem ïa uta u ’tiewshiah.
Me ong, ‘Peit, nga la jop ïa ki Edom,’ bad ka dohnud jong me ka la sngew hangamei. Hynrei shong ha ïing ! Balei men kynroi, ïoh me kyllon ei, ma me bad baroh shi Juda ?”
Hynrei u Amazia um sngap naba u Blei U la mut ban aiti ïa ki ha ki kti ki nongshun jong ki na ka daw ba ki la phai sha ki blei Edom.
Kumta u Joash syiem Israel u la leit kiew. Ma u bad u Amazia syiem Juda ki la ïakynduh mar pyrshah ha ka thma ha Beth-shemesh, ka jaka Juda.
Ki Juda ki la shah jop ha ki Israel, bad man la u briew u la phet sha la shnong la shnong.

U Joash syiem Israel u la ïoh kem ïa u Amazia syiem Juda, u khun u Jehoash, u khun u Ahazia, ha Beth-shemesh, bad u la ïalam ïa u sha Jerusalem. U la pyntwa ïa ka kynroh Jerusalem kumba sawspah pruh naduh ka Khyrdop Ephraim haduh ka Khyrdop Dong.

U la knieh baroh ka ksiar bad ka rupa, ïa ki khiew ki pliang baroh katba don ha ka ïing u Blei, bad ïa u Obed-Edom ruh bad ki. U la shim ïa ki jynkynshew ka ïing syiem, bad sa ki koidi jamin ruh, nangta u la wan phai sha Samaria.
U Amazia, khun u Jehoash syiem Juda, u la im sa khatsan snem hadien ka jingïap u Joash khun u Jehoahas syiem Israel.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Amazia, naduh basdang haduh bakut, la thoh ha ka Kitab ki Syiem Juda bad Israel.
Naduh ka por ba u la lyndet ïa u Trai, la don kiba la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u ha Jerusalem, kumta u la phet sha Lakhish. Hynrei ki la thwet ïa u sha Lakhish bad ki la pynïap ïa u hangta.
Ki la wan rah ïa u halor ki kulai, bad la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Juda bad ki kpa tymmen jong u.
Ki paidbah baroh jong ka Juda ki la shim ïa u Ussia uba dang khathynriew snem ka ryta bad ki la thung syiem ïa u ban bud pateng ïa u kpa jong u u Amazia.
U la tei ïa ka Elath bad u la pynïoh biang ïa ka sha Juda, kane ka la long hadien ba u syiem Amazia u la ïohthiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u.
U Ussia u la don khathynriew snem ka ryta haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar sanphew ar snem ha Jerusalem. Ka kmie jong u, kaba kyrteng Jekolia, ka la long na Jerusalem.
U la pynsngewbha ïa u Trai, kumba la leh u kpa jong u, u Amazia.
U la aiti lut ïa lade ban wad ïa u Trai katba dang im u Zekharia uba la hikai ïa u ban tieng burom ïa u Blei. Katba u dang shakri ïa u Trai, u Blei U la pynmanbha ïa u.
U la leit ïaleh thma ïa ki Philistia bad u la pyntwa ïa ki kynroh jong ka Gath, jong ka Jabne, bad jong ka Ashdod, nangta u la tei ki shnong ha ka ilaka Ashdod bad shawei pat ha ri Philistia.
U Blei U la ïarap ïa u pyrshah ki Philistia bad pyrshah ki Arab kiba shong ha Gur-Baal, bad pyrshah ki nong Meun.
Ki Ammon ki la siew khajna ha u Ussia bad ka nam jong u ka la phriang shaduh khap-pud Ijipt, namar u la kylla long u bakhlaiñ bor.
Nalor nangta, u Ussia u la tei ki ïing kut ha Jerusalem ha ka Khyrdop Dong, ha ka Khyrdop Them, bad ha ka Khongdong, nangta u sa pynskhem ïa ki.

U la tei ki ïing kut ha ri kynjah, bad u la tih shibun ki pukri, namar u la don shibun ki kynhun jynri ha Shephela bad ha rmen, u la don ki nongrep bad ki nongpeit ïa ki brisoh waiñ ha ri lum bad ha ki lyngkha kiba seisoh. U long uba ieid ïa ka rep ka riang.

Nangta u Ussia u la don ka kynhun ki shipai kiba la tbit bha ban ïaleh thma, ba la bynta kynhun kynhun, katkum ka jingkheiñ ba la shim da u Jeïel nongthoh bad u Maaseïa nongbuh jingkheiñ, hapoh ka jingïalam u Hanania u rangbah pyrton syiem.
Baroh ki rangbah ïing kur jong kine ki ’riewïaleh ki bashlur ki la long arhajar hynriewspah ngut.
Hapoh ka bor ïalam jong ki la don ka kynhun shipai kaba don laispah hynñiew hajar sanspah ngut ki briew kiba lah ban ïaleh thma da ka borbah, ban ïada ïa u syiem pyrshah ki nongshun.
U Ussia u la pynkhreh na ka bynta ki pyrton baroh, ki stieh, ki sum, ki tupia nar, ki jynphong nar, ki ryntieh bad ki maw talaiñ.

Ha Jerusalem u la thaw ki kor, ba la shem buit da ki stad, bad u la buh ïa ki ha ki kut bad ki dong, ban siat khnam bad ban kawang ïa ki maw heh. Ka nam jong u ka la phriang shaduh sha jngai, namar u la ïoh jingïarap ka baphylla, kaba la pynkhlaiñ bor ïa u haduh katta katta.

Hynrei katba u nangkhrawbor, katta u nangsarong, bad kane ka la long ka jingjot jong u. Da kaba tamsneng ïa u Trai u Blei jong u, u la rung hapoh ka tempyl u Trai ban thang jyniwbih ha ka duwan jyniwbih.
Te u Azaria lyngdoh u la leit rung nadien jong u lem bad phraphew ngut ki lyngdoh kiba shynrang mynsiem.

Ki la pyn-eh ïa u syiem Ussia, bad ki la ong ha u, “Ym dei ma phi, ko Ussia ban thang jyniwbih ha u Trai, hynrei tang ki lyngdoh, ki khun u Aron, kiba la ïoh jingpynkyntang ban thang jyniwbih. Mih noh na ka jaka kyntang, namar phi la leh bymdei, bad phin ym ïoh burom na u Trai u Blei.”

Hangta u Ussia u la bitar. Te u la don ka tiar dhup ha ka kti ban thang jyniwbih, bad haba u la khie dom ïa ki lyngdoh, u ’ñiangthohlieh u la paw ha ka shyllangmat jong u, hakhmat kita ki lyngdoh ha ka ïing u Trai, hajan ka duwan jyniwbih.

Haba u Azaria lyngdoh rangbah, bad ki lyngdoh baroh, ki la ïohi ba u la ïoh ’ñiangthohlieh ha ka shyllangmat, ki la khynñiat kloi kloi ïa u shabar. U hi u la pynkloi ban mih shabar, namar u Trai U la sympat ïa u.

U syiem Ussia u la pang ’ñiangthohlieh haduh ka sngi jingïap. Namarba u pang ’ñiangthohlieh u la shong ha ka ïing ka bakyrpang, naba la tait noh ïa u na ka ïing u Trai. U khun jong u u Jotham u la peit ïa ki kam ïing kam sem, bad u la synshar ïa ki briew ka ri.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Ussia, naduh basdang haduh bakut, la thoh da u nongïathuhlypa Isaïa, u khun u Amos.

U Ussia u la ïohthiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad ki la tep ïa u ha ki jaka tep briew ba dei jong ki syiem, namar ki la ong, “U dei uba pang ’ñiangthohlieh.” Te u Jotham u khun jong u u la mihbteng ïa u ha ka jingsynshar.
U Jotham u la don arphew san snem ka ryta haba u la sdang ban long syiem, bad u la synshar khat-hynriew snem ha Jerusalem. Ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka Jerusha, ka khun u Zadok.
U la leh ïa kaba u Trai U sngewbha, kumba la leh u kpa jong u u Ussia. Hynrei um shym rung ha ka jaka kyntang jong u Trai. Pynban ki paidbah ki dang leh sniew.
U la tei ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaneng jong ka ïing u Trai, bad u la tei shuh shuh shibun halor ka kynroh Ophel.
Nalor nangta u la tei ki shnong ha ri lum Juda lem bad ki kut bad ki ïing ap phira ha ki lum khlaw.

U la ïaleh thma bad ki Ammon bad u la jop ïa ki. Ha kata ka snem ki Ammon ki la ai shispah talen ka rupa, shiphew hajar busta u kew bad shiphew hajar busta u barli. Ha ka snem ka ba-ar bad ka balai ki Ammon ki la siew katjuh.
Kumta u Jotham u la kylla long u badonbor, namarba u la kohnguh ïa u Trai u Blei jong u.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam, ki thma baroh bad ka rukom im jong u Jotham, la thoh ha ka Kitab jong ki Syiem Israel bad Juda.
U la don arphew san snem ka ryta haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar khathynriew snem ha Jerusalem.
Te u Jotham u la ïohthiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad ki la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid. U Ahas u khun jong u u la synshar hadien jong u.

U Ahas u la don arphew snem ka ryta haba u la sdang ban synshar bad u la synshar khathynriew snem ha Jerusalem. Um shym la leh satia ïa kaba pynsngewbha ïa u Trai, kumba la leh u kpa tymmen jong u u Dabid,
hynrei u la pyrthuh ïa ka rukom im ki syiem Israel. U la thaw ki dur blei ba shu saiñ ïa ki Baal,
u la thang jyniwbih ha ka them u khun u Hinnom, bad u la thang ïa la ki khun kum ki jyntyrwa, katkum ka dustur leh ka ba-ijli jong ki jait bynriew kiba u Trai U la beh krad hakhmat ki Israel.
U la kñia bad la thang jyniwbih ha ki duwan halor lum, ha kliar ki lum, bad ha man la u dieng lymmuh.

Namarkata u Trai u Blei jong u U la aiti ïa u ha ka kti u syiem Siria. Une u la jop ïa u bad u la ring koidi shibun bah u paid jong u shaduh Damaskus. La aiti ruh ïa u ha ki kti u syiem Israel uba la jop ïa u da ka jingpynïap ka bashyrkhei.
Kane ka la jia haba u Peka, u khun u Remalia, u la pynïap ha ka shi sngi shispah arphew hajar ngut ki Juda, baroh ki ’riewshlur suda, namarba ki la lyndet ïa u Trai, u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki.
U Zikhri, u ’riewkhlaiñ na Ephraim, u la pynïap ïa u Maaseïa u khun u syiem, ïa u Asrikam rangbah pyrton ka ïing syiem bad ïa u Elkana u myntri rangbah u syiem.
Ki Israel ki la kem koidi ïa la ki kur ki jait arspah hajar ngut, bad tnga bad khun shynrang bad khun kynthei. Ki la knieh ruh shibun bah ka mar kliarwait na ki, bad ki la wan rah ïa ka sha Samaria.

U nongïathuhlypa jong u Blei uba kyrteng u Oded u la don hangta, bad u la leit ban ïakynduh ïa ki pyrton kiba wan phai sha Samaria. Te u la ong ha ki, “Dei namarba u Trai, u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong phi, U la bitar ïa ki Juda, ba U la aiti ïa ki ha ki kti jong phi; hynrei phi la pynïap ïa ki da ka jingleh sat kaba la poi haduh bneng.
Mynta pat phi mut ban ïuh roit ïa ki Juda, shynrang bad kynthei, la kum ïa ki mraw. Ha ong, phi phim don la ki kam bymman pyrshah ïa u Trai u Blei jong phi ?
Sngap ïa nga mynta, to phah noh ïa ki koidi kiba phi la ring napdeng ki para kur para jait jong phi, namar u Trai U la bitar lep ïa phi.”
Don ki rangbah napdeng ki Ephraim, u Azaria u khun u Johanan, u Berekhia u khun u Meshillemoth, u Jehiskia u khun u Shallum, bad u Amasa u khun u Hadlai, kiba la ïeng pyn-eh ïa kito kiba wan na thma,

bad ki la ong kumne, “Phim dei ban wan ïalam koidi hangne, namar kaba phi mut ban leh kan pynkit pap halor jong ngi pyrshah ïa u Trai nalor ki kam sniew bad ki kam bymman ba ngi la don. Ka pap jong ngi ka la long lypa ka bakhraw, bad ka jingbitar ïa ki Israel ka long ka basngewtriem.”
Kumta ki pyrton thma ki la ieh noh ïa ki koidi bad ïa ka mar kliarwait hakhmat ki rangbah hima bad u paidlang baroh.

Kitei ki briew, ba la jer da ka kyrteng, ki la ïeng bad ki la shimti ïa ki koidi. Da ka mar kliarwait ki la pynkup ïa ki balyngkhuit baroh. Nalor ba pynkup ïa ki, ki la ai juti, ka bam ka dih, bad ki la pynsleh ïa ki; ïa ki batlot ki la pynshong ha ki kada. Ki la leit ïalam ïa ki sha ki para jong ki shaduh Jerikho, ka shnong ki dieng tlai; nangta ki sa wan phai sha Samaria.
Ha kata ka por u syiem Ahas u la pan jingïarap na u syiem Assiria.
Ki Edom ki la hiar thma biang, ki la jop ïa ki Juda, bad ki la ring koidi.

Sa ki Philistia ki la hiar lute ïa ki shnong kiba ha Shephela bad ha Nekeb jong ka Juda. Ki la knieh ruh ïa ka Beth-shemesh, ïa ka Aijalon, ïa ka Gederoth, ïa ka Soko bad ïa ki nongrit jong ka, ïa ka Timna bad ki nongrit jong ka, bad ïa ka Gimzo bad ki nongrit jong ka; bad ki la buhai shnong artat hangta.
U Trai U la pyndem ïa ka Juda na ka daw u Ahas syiem Israel, namar u la leh pathar ïa ka Juda bad um kohnguh shuh ïa u Trai.
Kumta u Tiglath-Pileser syiem Assiria u la wan pyrshah ïa u, bad u la pynjynjar ïa u ha ka jaka ban pynkhlaiñ ïa u.
Wat la u Ahas u la shim na ka ïing u Trai, na ka ïing syiem bad na ki bakhraw batri ban siew ïa u syiem Assiria, kata ruh kam shym pynmyntoi ei ei ïa u.
Katba u nangngat ha ka jinglanot, katta une u syiem Ahas u nangpyrshah ïa u Trai.

U la kñia ha ki blei Damaskus kiba la jop ïa u, bad u la ong, “Namarba ki blei jong ki syiem Siria ki la ïarap ïa ki, nga ruh ngan kñia ha ki ba kin dup ïarap lem ïa nga.” Phewse ki la long ka jingjot ïa u bad ïa ki Israel baroh.

Te u Ahas u la lum lang ïa ki khiew ki pliang ka ïing u Blei bad u la pynpait ïa ki lyngkhot lyngkhai. U la khang ïa ki jynkhang ka ïing u Trai bad u la thaw ki duwan na ka bynta ïa lade ha man la ki dong ka Jerusalem.
Ha man la ki shnong Juda u la thaw ki duwan halor lum ban thang jyniwbih ha kiwei pat ki blei. Kumta u la pynbitar ïa u Trai u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong u.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam bad ki rukom leh jong u, naduh basdang haduh bakut, la thoh ha ka Kitab jong ki Syiem Juda bad Israel.
Te u Ahas u la ïohthiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad ki la tep ïa u ha Jerusalem ha ka nongbah ym dei ha ki jyntep jong ki syiem Israel. U khun jong u u Hezekia u la synshar hadien jong u.
U Hezekia u la don arphew san snem ka ryta haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar arphew khyndai snem ha Jerusalem. Ka kmie jong u ka kyrteng ka Abija, ka khun u Zekharia.
U la pynsngewbha ïa u Trai, kumba la leh u kpa tymmen jong u u Dabid.
Ha ka snem ka banyngkong jong ka jingsynshar jong u, ha u bnai u banyngkong, u la plie ïa ki khyrdop ka ïing u Trai, bad u la maramot ïa ki.
U la khot ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi, bad u la lum lang ïa ki ha ka lympung kaba shaphang mihngi.
Te u la ong ha ki, “Sngap ïa nga, ko Lebi ! To pynkhuid pynkyntang ïa lade mynta, to pynkhuid ïa ka ïing u Trai, u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong phi, bad weng noh ïa ka jakhlia na ka jaka bakhuid.
Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la leh bymkohnguh bad ki la leh bymman hakhmat u Trai u Blei jong ngi. Ki la kyntait ïa U, ki la phai ïa la ki khmat na ka jaka shong u Trai, bad ki la lyndet ïa U.
Ki la khang ïa ki jynkhang ka batsha, ki la pynlip ïa ki sharak, bad kim thang jyniwbih shuh, ne tyrwa jynkñia thang ha ka jaka bakhuid ha u Blei ki Israel.

Kumta ka jingbitar u Trai ka la wan hiar halor ka Juda bad ka Jerusalem, bad U la pynngat ïa ki ha ka jingshyrkhei, ha ka jingdum buit, bad ha ka jingshah kynshi, kumba phi ïohi da ki khmat jong phi hi.
Hakhmih, ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la kyllon da ka waitlam, ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong ngi ki la kylla koidi na ka bynta kane.
Mynta ka long ka jingkwah jong nga ban ïateh jutang bad u Trai, u Blei ki Israel, khnang ba ka jingbitar jong U ka ba-itieng kan kynran noh na ngi.
Ko khun jong nga, wat leh bymsuitñiew shuh mynta, namar u Trai U la jied ïa phi ban ïeng hakhmat jong U, ban shakri ïa U, ban long ki myntri jong U, bad ban thang jyniwbih ha U.”

Kumta ki Lebi ki la ïeng joit; u Mahath u khun u Amasai bad u Joel u khun u Azaria, ki khun shynrang na ka ïing kur ki Kohath; na ki khun u Merari, u Kish u khun u Abdi, bad u Azaria u khun u Jehallelel; na ki Gershon, u Joa u khun u Zimma, bad u Eden u khun u Joa;
na ki khun u Elisaphan, u Shimri bad u Jeuel; na ki khun u Asaph, u Zekharia bad u Mattania;
na ki khun u Heman, u Jehuwel bad u Shimei; na ki khun u Jeduthun, u Shemaïa bad u Ussiel.
Ki la ïalang para kur para jait, ki la pynkhuid ïa lade, bad ki la leit rung kumba la hukum u syiem, da ka ktien u Trai, ban pynkhuid ïa ka ïing jong u Trai.

Ki lyngdoh ki la leit rung ha ka jaka bashapoh jong ka ïing u Trai ban pynkhuid ïa ka, bad ki la sei ïa ka kynja bymkhuid baroh katba ki shem hapoh tempyl u Trai sha ka phyllaw jong ka ïing u Trai; nangta ki Lebi pat ki la shim ïa ka bad ki la rah sha wah Kidron.

Ki la sdang ban pynkhuid ha ka sngi banyngkong jong u bnai banyngkong, bad ha ka sngi baphra jong uta u bnai ki la wan sha ka batsha u Trai. Kumta phra sngi lynter ki la pynkhuid ïa ka ïing u Trai, bad ha ka sngi kaba khathynriew jong u bnai banyngkong ki la dep.

Nangta ki la leit sha u syiem Hezekia bad ki la ong, “Ngi la pynkhuid ïa ka ïing u Trai baroh kawei, ïa ka duwan ki jynkñia thang, ïa ki khiew ki pliang baroh, ïa ka miej u ’pu-pyni bad ïa ki khiew ki pliang jong ka baroh.
Ïa ki khiew ki pliang baroh kiba u syiem Ahas u la bret haba u dang synshar namar ka jingleh sang jong u, ngi la pynryntih bad pynkhuid. Ki don hakhmat ka duwan u Trai.”
Te u syiem Hezekia u la khie dangstep phyrngap, u la lum lang ïa ki ’riewrangbah jong ka nongbah, bad u la leit kiew sha ka ïing u Trai.

Ki la wan rah hynñiew tylli ki masi kyrtong, hynñiew tylli ki langbrot, hynñiew tylli ki khun langbrot, bad hynñiew tylli ki blang kum ka jynkñia sait pap ba dei ïa ka hima, ïa ka jaka kyntang bad ïa ka ri Juda. Nangta u la hukum ïa ki lyngdoh, ki khun u Aron, ban tyrwa ïa ki ha ka duwan u Trai.

Kumta ki la pynïap ïa ki masi kyrtong bad ki lyngdoh ki la pdiang ïa ka snam bad ki la synreit ha ka duwan. Ki la pynïap sa ïa ki langbrot, bad ïa ka snam jong ki la synreit ha ka duwan; la pynïap sa ïa ki khun langbrot bad ïa ka snam jong ki la synreit ha ka duwan.
Nangta ïa ki blang na ka bynta ka jingsait pap la wan ïalam sha u syiem bad u paidlang, bad kine ki la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ki.

Ki lyngdoh ki la pynïap ïa ki, ki la pynlong ka jingkñia sait pap da ka snam jong ki halor ka duwan ban pynbiang na ka bynta ki Israel baroh. U syiem u la hukum ba ïa ka jingkñia thang bad ka jingkñia sait pap dei ban tyrwa na ka bynta ki Israel baroh.

U syiem u la buh ïa ki Lebi ha ka ïing u Trai bad ki ’singpadiah, ki duitara bad ki marynthing, kumba la hukum u Dabid, u Gad u kunok syiem, bad u Nathan nongïathuhlypa, namarba ka hukum jong u Trai ka la wan lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa jong U.
Ki Lebi ki la ïeng bad ki jyntem u Dabid, ki lyngdoh pat bad ki turoi.

Nangta u Hezekia u la hukum ban tyrwa ïa ki jynkñia thang halor ka duwan. Haba la sdang ki jingkñia thang, ka jingrwai ha u Trai ruh ka la sdang, bad la pynbud ïa ki da ki jyntem u Dabid u syiem Israel.
Ka jingïakynduh baroh kawei ka la mane, ki nongrwai ki la rwai, bad ki nongput turoi ki la put. Kane baroh ka la neh haduh ban da dep ka jingkñia thang.
Ynda ka jingkñia ka la dep, u syiem bad ki briew baroh kiba ïadon bad u ki la dem bad ki la mane.
U syiem Hezekia bad ki rangbah nongïalam ki la hukum ïa ki Lebi ban rwai jingïaroh ha u Trai da ki ktien u Dabid bad u Asaph u kunok. Te ki la rwai jingïaroh da ka jingkmen, ki la dem bad ki la mane.

Nangta u Hezekia u la ong, “Ba phi la pynkyntang mynta ïa lade ha u Trai, ale shane shajan, wan rah ïa ki jynkñia bad ki jyntyrwa ainguh ha ïing u Trai.” Kumta uta u paidlang u la wan rah ki jynkñia bad ki jyntyrwa ainguh, bad ki jyntyrwa thang, kum ki jynai mon sngewbha.

Ki jyntyrwa thang baroh ba la wan rah uta u paidlang ki long hynñiewphew tylli ki masi kyrtong, shispah tylli ki langbrot bad arspah tylli ki khun langbrot. Kine baroh ki la long ki jingkñia thang ha u Trai.
Ki jyntyrwa ba la pynkyntang ki la long hynriew spah tylli ki masi kyrtong bad lai hajar tylli ki langbrot.

Hynrei ki lyngdoh ki khyndiat eh bad kim lah ban puidsnieh ïa ki jynkñia thang baroh. Kumta katba kiwei pat ki lyngdoh ki la pynkhuid ïalade, ki para jong ki ki Lebi ki la ïarap ïa ki, hangta ka kam ka sa dep namar ki Lebi ki kham beit mynsiem ban ïa ki lyngdoh ha kaba pynkhuid ïa lade.

Nalor ki jynkñia thang shikatdei bah, la don sa ka khleiñ jong ki jynkñia jingsuk, bad la don ruh ki jynsuit na ka bynta ki jynkñia thang. Ha kane ka rukom ïa ka jinglehniam ha ïing u Trai la pynbit biang.
Te u Hezekia bad u paidbah baroh ki la risa ïa ka jingleh bha u Blei na ka bynta ki paidbah, bad namarba ka la wan kynsan kynsan.

Te u Hezekia u la phah ktien sha ki Israel bad ki Juda baroh, bad u la thoh shithi ruh sha ki Ephraim bad ki Manasse ba ki dei ban wan sha ka ïing u Trai ha Jerusalem ban rakhe ïa ka Paskha na ka bynta ka burom u Trai u Blei ki Israel.
U syiem, ki rangbah nongïalam bad u paidlang baroh ki la ïahap jingmut lang ban leh burom paskha ha Jerusalem ha u bnai u ba-ar
namarba kim shym lah ban rakhe ïa ka ha ka por babiang, artat namarba ym pat don lyngdoh kiba la pynkyntang ïa lade kat ban biang, bad ba u paidbah ruh um pat ïalang ha Jerusalem.
Kane ka jingpynbeit ka la idei ha u syiem bad ki paidbah baroh.

Kumta ki la rai ban pynbna ha ri Israel baroh naduh Beersheba haduh Dan ba ki paidbah baroh ki dei ban wan rakhe ïa ka Paskha na ka bynta ka burom u Trai u Blei ki Israel ha Jerusalem, namarba kim shym la rakhe ïa ka da u paid shibun bah kumba la hukum.

Kumta ki dak kiba rah ïa ki shithi ba la thoh da u syiem bad ki rangbah nongïalam ki la leit kylleng ka Juda bad ka Israel, bad da ka hukum u syiem ki la ong, “Ko paid Israel, to wan phai sha u Trai, u Blei u Abraham, u Isaak bad u Israel, ba Un dup phai biang sha phi kiba dang sah bad kiba la lait-im na ki kti jong ki syiem Assiria.
Wat long satia kum ki kpa tymmen bad ki hynmen jong phi kiba la tamsneng ïa u Trai u Blei ki kpa jong ki haduh ba U la pynlko pom ïa ki kumba phi hi phi ïohi.

Wat leh mutlop kum ki kpa tymmen jong phi, hynrei to pyndem ïa lade ha u Trai, bad to wan noh sha ka ïing bakhuid jong U kaba U la pynkyntang junom. To shakri ïa u Trai u Blei jong phi, khnang ba ka jingbitar ba-itriem jong U kan phai noh na phi.

Lada phi wan phai sha u Trai, ki hynmen para bad ki khun ki kti jong phi kin ïoh jingisynei na kita kiba la kem koidi ïa ki, bad kin ïoh wan phai noh sha kane ka ri. Naba u Trai U long u basbun bad u ba-isynei, bad Un ym phai noh ïa la ka khmat na phi, lada phi wan phai sha U.”
Kumta ki dak ki la leit na kawei ka shnong sha kawei pat kylleng ka ri Ephraim bad Manasse, wat shaduh Zebulun. Hynrei ki la shah rkhiebeiñ bad shah kynshi.
Tang khyndiat ngut kiba na Asher, na Manasse, bad na Zebulun, ki la pynrit ïa lade bad ki la wan sha Jerusalem.
Hynrei ka kti u Trai ka la ktah ïa ki Juda: ka la ai ïa ki kawei ka dohnud ban leh kat ïa kaba u syiem bad ki rangbah nongïalam ki la hukum da ka ktien u Trai.
Kumta buk bak u paid u la ïalang ha Jerusalem ban rakhe ïa ka niam ka rukom jong u Kpu khlem thiat ha u bnai ba-ar. Ka la long ka jingïakynduh ka bakhraw.
Ki la sdang ban trei da kaba weng noh ïa ki duwan kiba don ha Jerusalem. Ki la weng noh ïa ki duwan na ka bynta ban thang jyniwbih bad ki la bret ha them Kidron.

Te ki la pynïap ïa u khun langbrot paskha ha ka sngi ka bakhatsaw jong u bnai u ba-ar. Ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi, ba ki la sngewlehraiñ, ki la pynkhuid ïa lade, bad ki la wan rah ki jyntyrwa thang ha ka ïing u Trai.
Ki la ïeng ha la ki jaka badei riti katkum ka aiñ u Moses u briew u Blei. Ki lyngdoh ki la synreit ïa ka snam kaba ki la pdiang na ka kti ki Lebi.
Namarba la donbun na u paidlang kibym pat shym pynkyntang ïa lade, ki Lebi ki la dei ban pynïap u langbrot paskha na ka bynta uwei pa uwei u briew u bym pat khuid, ba un dup long u bakhuid ha u Trai.

U paidbah byllien, khamtam na Ephraim, Manasse, Issakhar, bad Zebulun, kim pat shym pynkhuid ïa lade. Pynban ki la bam la ka bam ïa ka paskha pyrshah ïa ka aiñ. Hynrei u Hezekia u la duwai na ka bynta jong ki, u da ong, “To u Trai, ba U long u babha, Un map ïa uwei pa uwei
uba kut jingmut ban wad ïa u Blei, u Trai u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong u, wat la um long u bakhuid kat kumba ki aiñ jingkhuid jong ka ïingblei ki dawa.”
U Trai U la sngap ïa u Hezekia, bad U la pyllait ïa ki paidbah.

Te ki paidbah Israel kiba ïadon ha Jerusalem ki la rakhe ïa ka jingkhawai niam jong u kpu khlem thiat hynñiew sngi da ka jingkmen ka bakhraw. Ki Lebi bad ki lyngdoh pat ki la ïaroh ïa u Trai man la ka sngi, ki da rwai ha u Trai katba kot ka bor jong ki.

U Hezekia u la pynshlur ïa ki Lebi baroh kiba la pynpaw jingnang ha kaba shakri ïa u Trai. Kumta ki paidbah ki la bam ïa ka jynbam sngi khawai niam kumba hynñiew sngi, bad ki la kñia ïa ki jyntyrwa ïabha ïamiat, da kaba ainguh ïa u Trai u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki.
Te u paidlang baroh u la ïamynjur lang ban rakhe ïa kane ka jingkhawai niam sa hynñiew sngi lynter, bad ki la rakhe ïa ka sa hynñiew sngi da ka jingkmen.

U Hezekia, syiem Juda, u la ai sngewbha ha u paidlang shihajar tylli ki masi kyrtong bad hynñiew hajar tylli ki langbrot na ka bynta ki jynkñia; ki rangbah nongïalam pat ki la ai sngewbha ha ka jingïakynduh shihajar tylli ki masi kyrtong bad shiphew hajar tylli ki langbrot. Shibun bah ki lyngdoh ki la pynkhuid ïa lade.
U paidlang Juda baroh, lem bad ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi, u paidlang baroh uba la wan na Israel lem bad ki soh shnong kiba la wan na ri Israel bad kiba shong ha ri Juda, ki la kmen.
Kumta la don ka jingleh kmen ka bakhraw ha Jerusalem; naduh ka por jong u Solomon, khun u Dabid, syiem Israel, ym pat ju don kaba kum kane ha Jerusalem.
Te ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ki la ïeng bad ki la kyrkhu ïa u paidbah. Ïa ka sur jong ki la ïohsngew bad ka jingduwai jong ki ka la poi haduh ha bneng, ka jaka shong bakhuid jong u Blei.

Te ynda la dep kane baroh kito ki Israel kiba la ïadon ki la leit sha ki shnong Juda bad ki la pynpait lwet ïa ki rishot, ki la pom pynkyllon ïa ki Asherim, ki la pyntwa ïa ki duwan halor lum bad ïa ki duwan kylleng ka Juda, ka Benjamin, ka Ephraim bad ka Manasse, haduh ba la pynjot ïa ki baroh phar. Hadien kata ki paid Israel ki la leit phai sha la ki shnong ki shnong, man la u briew sha la ka jaka lajong.

U Hezekia u la bate ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ha la ki kynhun; uwei pa uwei u ïoh la ka deiti ha la ka kynhun lada dei u lyngdoh ne u Lebi, na ka bynta ki jingtyrwa thang ne ki jingtyrwa ïabha ïamiat, na ka bynta ka jingshakri ha ki khyrdop jong ka ïing dara u Trai, ban ainguh ne ban ïaroh.

U syiem u la ai ïa la ka bynta na ki spah lajong na ka bynta ki jingtyrwa thang, kiba dei mynstep bad janmiet, kiba dei ha ki sabath, ha ki ’naithymmai bad ki jingkhawai niam kiba la buh, kumba la thoh ha ka aiñ u Trai.
U la hukum ïa ki briew kiba shong ha Jerusalem ban ai ïa ka bynta kaba hap ha ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi khnang ba kin dup lah ban aiti lut ïa lade ha ka Aiñ u Trai.

Te haba la pynbna kylleng ïa kane ka hukum, ki paidbah Israel ki la ai pahuh ïa ki soh nyngkong na u kew, na ka waiñ, na ka umphniang, na ka ngap bad na ki jingmih lyngkha baroh. Ki la wan rah pahuh ïa ka bynta ka bashiphew jong kiei kiei baroh.

Ki paid Israel bad Juda ruh kiba shong ha ki shnong Juda ki la wan rah ïa ka bashiphew na ki masidab bad ki langbrot bad na kiei kiei ki bakhuid ïa kiba la pynkyntang ha u Trai u Blei jong ki bad ki la buh kynton ïa ki.
Dei ha u bnai u balai ba ki la sdang ban buh kynton ïa ki, bad ki la pyndep ha u bnai u bahynñiew.
Haba u Hezekia bad ki rangbah nongïalam ki la wan bad ki la ïohi ïa ki kynton, ki la kyrkhu ïa u Trai bad ïa ki paid jong U ki Israel.
U Hezekia u la kylli ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi shaphang ki kynton.

U Azaria u lyngdoh rangbah uba dei na ka ïing u Zadok u la jubab, “Naduh ba ki la sdang ban wan rah ïa ki synñiang ha ïing u Trai, ngi la ïoh ban bam haban da biang, bad dang tam ruh; naba u Trai U la kyrkhu ïa la u paid, kumta ngi don katne ka jynkynshew kaba dang sah.”
Te u Hezekia u la hukum ïa ki ban pynkhreh ki kamra ha ka ïing u Trai. Ynda ki la pynkhreh,
ki la wan rah beit ïa ki synñiang, ïa ki bashiphew bad ïa kiei kiei kiba la kyrkhu. U rangbah duh uba peit ïa ki u dei u Konania u Lebi, lem bad u Shimei, u para jong u, hapoh jong u.

U Jehiel, u Azazia, u Nahath, u Asahel, u Jerimoth, u Jozabad, u Eliel, u Ismakhia, u Mahath, bad u Benaïa ki la long pat de ki nongïarap peit hapoh u Konania bad u Shimei u para jong u, bad ïa ki la thung da u syiem Hezekia bad u Azaria u rangbah duh jong ka ïing u Blei.

U Kore khun u Imna u Lebi, u nongap jong ka khyrdop kaba sha mihngi, u la long u nongpeit ïa ki jyntyrwa mon sngewbha ha u Blei. Une u bate ïa u synñiang ba dei kyrpang ha u Trai bad ïa ki jyntyrwa ki bakhuid tam.
U Eden, u Miniamin, u Jeshwa, u Shemaïa, u Amaria bad u Shekania ki ïarap tista ïa u ha ki shnong lyngdoh, ban sam ïa ki bhah ha ki kur jong ki, tymmen bad samla katjuh, shikynhun kynhun.

Nalor kine, la don kito ki shynrang ïa kiba la buh jingkheiñ katkum ka jinghiar pateng, kiba naduh laiphew snem shaneng; kine ki la bit ban rung ha ka ïing u Trai kumba dawa ka deiti jong ki man la ka sngi, na ka bynta ka jinglehniam, ha la ka pali pali.
Haba buh jingkheiñ ïa ki lyngdoh, ka la long katkum ki ïing kur, hynrei ïa ki Lebi kiba naduh arphew snem shaneng ka la long katkum ki kam jong ki, ha la ka kynhun kynhun.
Ïa ki lyngdoh, ïa ki khun rit jong ki, ïa ki tnga, ki khun shynrang, bad ki khun kynthei jong ki, baroh shipaid, ki la sam bynta: namarba ki la dei ban aiti ïa lade ha ki kam bakhuid.

Na ka bynta ki khun ki kti u Aron, ki lyngdoh, kiba shong ba sah ha ki jaka bam phlang jong ki shnong jong ki, la don ki briew ba la buh kyrpang ha bun bah ki shnong ban sam ïa la ki bynta bynta ha man la u shynrang hapdeng ki lyngdoh bad ha man la u briew ba la buh jingkheiñ hapdeng ki Lebi.
U Hezekia u la leh kumne ha ri Juda baroh kawei. U la leh ïa ka babha, ka badei bad ka bashonghok hakhmat u Trai u Blei jong u.

Ïa kano kano ka kam ba u la leh na ka bynta ka jinglehniam ha ka ïing u Blei, na ka bynta ka Aiñ bad ki Hukum, u la leh ban pyndep ïa ka mon u Blei. U la leh da ka dohnud jong u baroh, kumta u la manbha.
Hadien kine ki kam ka jingshakri hok, u Sennakherib syiem Assiria u la wan. U la hiar thma ïa ka Juda bad u la sher dara mar pyrshah ki shnong kut, u da pyrkhat ban jop kloi ïa ki.
Haba u Hezekia u la ïohi ba u Sennakherib u la wan da ka jingthmu ban hiar thma ïa ka Jerusalem,
u la thaw buit bad ki rangbah pyrton lem bad ki ’riewkhlaiñ jong u ban set ïa ka um na ki umpohliew kiba shabar ka nongbah. Kine ki mynjur,
bad shibun bah ki briew ki la wan ïalum, bad ki la set ïa ki umpohliew baroh bad ïa ka wahduid kaba tuid lyngba ka ri. Ki ong, “Balei ki syiem Assiria ki dei ban ïoh um shibun haba ki wan?”

U Hezekia u la sdang ban trei dukhi dukhait: u la tei ïa ka kynroh kaba la twa, u la pynïeng ki jaka ap phira halor jong ka, bad shabar jong ka u la tei sa kawei pat ka kynroh. U la pynkhlaiñ ïa ka Millo kaba ha ka Nongbah u Dabid, nangta u la thaw sa ki sum bad ki stieh shikatdei.
U la thung ki rangbah ban ïalam ïa ki paid ïaleh thma, bad u la lum lang ïa ki sawdong jong u ha ka lympung kaba ha khyrdop jong ka nongbah, bad u la kren pynshlur ïa ki, u ong,
“To long ki bakhlaiñ bad ki bashlur. Wat sheptieng ne khaw-eit ïa u syiem Assiria bad ïa ki kynhun thma jong u baroh, namar Uta Uba don bad ngi U kham khlaiñ ban ïa uta uba don bad u.
Ma u u don ka ksangti doh; hynrei ma ngi ngi don u Trai, u Blei jong ngi, Uban ïarap ïa ngi bad Uban ïaleh ïa ki thma jong ngi.” Te ki paidbah ki la sngewshngaiñ ir na ki ktien u Hezekia syiem Juda.

Hadien kane u Sennakherib u syiem Assiria, katba u dang kerkut ïa ka Lakhish da ki pyrton jong u baroh, u la phah ïa la ki rangbah sha u Hezekia syiem Juda ha Jerusalem, bad sha ki paidbah Juda baroh kiba don ha Jerusalem, u ong,
“U Sennakherib syiem Assiria u ong kumne, ‘Haei phi shaniah, ba phi ïasah ha ka kut ha Jerusalem?

Hato ym dei u Hezekia uba ïalam bakla ïa phi, ba un dup pynïap ïa phi da ka jingthngan bad ka jingsliang, haba u ïathuh ïa phi hana ba u Trai u Blei jong phi Un sa pyllait ïa phi na ka kti u syiem Assiria?

Hato ym dei une ujuh u Hezekia uba la weng noh ïa ki duwan halor lum bad ïa ki duwan jong u bad uba la hukum ïa ka Juda bad Jerusalem, “Tang hakhmat kawei ka duwan phin ïamane, bad tang halor jong ka phin ïatyrwa jyniwbih?”

Phim tip mo aïu ma nga bad ki kpa tymmen jong nga ngi la leh ïa ki briew baroh kiba ha kiwei pat ki ri? Hato ki blei jong ki jait bynriew kiba ha kito ki ri ki la lah mo ban pyllait ïa la ki ri na ki kti jong nga?

Uei napdeng ki blei baroh jong kito ki jait bynriew kiba ki kpa tymmen jong nga ki la pynjot thiaw, uba la lah ban pyllait ïa ki briew na ka kti jong nga? Te katno lei lei sa u Blei jong phi hana ba Un pyllait ïa phi na ki kti jong nga?

Hei! wat shah shukor ne shah ïalam bakla ha u Hezekia ha kane ka rukom. Wat ngeit ïa u, namar ym pat ju don u blei jong kano kano ka jait bynriew ne ka hima, uba la lah ban pyllait ïa la ki briew na ki kti jong nga ne jong ki kpa tymmen jong nga. Katno lei lei da u Blei jong phi ba yn pyllait ïa phi na ki kti jong nga!’ ”
Ki rangbah jong u lei lei ki dang kren kham tyng-eh shuh shuh ïa u Trai u Blei bad ïa u shakri jong U u Hezekia,

haba u Sennakherib u la thoh shithi ban kren pynjah burom ïa u Trai u Blei ki Israel. U la thoh kumne pyrshah ïa U, “Kumba ki blei jong ki jait bynriew jong ki kim shym la pyllait ïa la ki briew na ki kti jong nga, kumta ruh u Blei u Hezekia Un ym pyllait ïa la ki briew na ki kti jong nga.”
Ki la pyrta da ka sur bajam ha ka ktien Juda ïa ki nong Jerusalem kiba don halor ka kynroh, ban pynsheptieng bad ban pynsngewtriem ïa ki, khnang ban dup ïoh knieh ïa ka nongbah.
Ki la kren ïa u Blei ka Jerusalem la kum ïa ki blei jong ki jait bynriew ka pyrthei kiba shu thaw da ki kti u briew.
Te kumta u syiem Hezekia bad u Isaïa nongïathuhlypa, u khun u Amos, ki la duwai bad la kyang sha bneng na ka bynta kane.

U Trai U la phah ïa u angel, uba la pom ïa ki ’riewïaleh ki bakhlaiñ bor, ïa ki rangbah pyrton bad ïa ki rangbah nongïalam baroh phar ha ka dara u syiem Assiria. Kumta u la leit phai da ka jinglehraiñ sha la ka ri. Te haba u la wan sha ka ïing u blei jong u, katto katne ngut ki khun jong u ki la pom ïa u hangta da ka waitlam.
Kumta u Trai u la pyllait ïa u Hezekia bad ïa kiba shong ha Jerusalem na ki kti u Sennakherib syiem Assiria bad na ka kti ki nongshun jong u baroh. U la ai jingsuk kynjai ïa ki na kylleng sawdong.

Hadien kata shibun ki briew ki la wan rah ki jynai sngewbha ha u Trai ha Jerusalem lem bad ki mar bakordor ïa u Hezekia syiem Juda. Kumta u la kiew burom hakhmat ki jait bynriew baroh ter shi ter naduh kata ka por.
Hadien kito ki sngi u Hezekia u la kem pang jur haduh ba u la poi ha tmier jingïap. U la duwai ïa u Trai Uba la jubab ïa u da kaba ai kawei ka dak.
Hynrei u Hezekia um shym sngewnguh katkum ka jingmyntoi ba u la ïoh, namarba u la don ka dohnud ka basarong. Kumta ka jingbitar ka la hiar ha u, bad halor ka Juda bad Jerusalem.
Hangta u Hezekia u la pynrit ïa ka jingsarong ka dohnud jong u, ma u lem bad ki nong Jerusalem; ynda kumta ka jingbitar u Trai kam shym wan shuh halor jong ki ha ki sngi u Hezekia.

Te u Hezekia u la ïoh shibun bah ka spah bad ka burom bad u la tei ka ïing jynkynshew na ka bynta ka rupa, ka ksiar, ki mawkordor, ki musla iwbih, ki stieh, bad ki khiew ki pliang har rukom ki baremdor.
Nangta sa ki ïing thiar na ka bynta u kew, ka waiñ bad ka umphniang; nangta pat sa ki sem ïa ki jait jynri har rukom bad ki sem langbrot.
U la tei ruh ki shnong na ka bynta ïa lade, bad u la pynïoh ki kynhun langbrot bad ki kynhun jynri shikatdei bah; namar u Blei U la ai ïa u shibun bah ka spah ka hajar.
Une u juh u Hezekia u la den ïa ka tlongum kaba shaneng jong ka Gihon bad u la pynïaid ïa ki um arsut sha sepngi ka Nongbah u Dabid. Te u Hezekia u la manbha ha ki kam jong u baroh.

La katta ruh ha ka kam shaphang ki nonglamktien ba la phah da ki rangbah syiem ka Babilon ban wad jingtip shaphang ka kam bah kam san kaba la jia ha ka ri, u Blei U la ieh noh ba un leh hi, khnang ban tynjuh ïa u bad ban dup tip ïa kata baroh kaba don ha ka dohnud jong u.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Hezekia, bad ïa ki kam babha jong u, la thoh ha ka Jingïohi paw u Isaïa u khun u Amos, ha ka Kitab ki Syiem Juda bad Israel.

U Hezekia u la ïohthiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad ki la tep ïa u ha ka ranab jong ki jyntep ba dei ïa ki khun ki kti u Dabid. Ka Juda bad ki nong Jerusalem baroh ki leh burom ïa u haba u la ïap. U khun jong u u Manasse u la synshar hadien jong u.
U Manasse u la don khat-ar snem ka ryta mynba u la sdang ban long syiem bad u la synshar sawphew san snem ha Jerusalem.
U la leh sniew hakhmat u Trai, da kaba bud ïa ki jingmlien ki ba-ijli jong ki jait bynriew kiba u Trai U la pynher krad nakhmat ki paid Israel.

Naba u la tei biang ïa ki ïingblei halor lum kiba u kpa jong u u Hezekia u la lah pyntwa, u la pynïeng ïa ki duwan ha ki Baal, u la thaw ki Ashera, u la mane ïa ki paid bneng baroh bad u la leh niam ha ki.
U la tei ruh ki duwan ha ka ïing u Trai, ïa kaba u Trai U la ong, “Ha Jerusalem ka ïing jong Nga ka dei ban sah junom.”
U la shna ki duwan na ka bynta ki paid bneng baroh ha ki artylli ki phyllaw jong ka ïing u Trai.

U la thang ïa la ki khun shynrang kum ki jynkñia ha ka Them Ben-Hinnom, u la leh ki kam jadu myntor bad kam byrtong, bad u la pynïadei kam bad ki rngai bad ki sna-ïap. U la leh sniew shibun eh hakhmat u Trai bad u la pynkhie bitar ïa U.

U la thaw ka dur blei bad u la pynïeng ïa ka ha ka ïing u Blei, ïa kaba u Blei U la ong ha u Dabid bad u Solomon u khun jong u, “Ha kane ka ïing kaba ha Jerusalem, kaba Nga la jied napdeng ki jait Israel, Ngan pynneh ïa ka kyrteng jong Nga junom.

Ngan ym weng shuh ïa ki kjat jong ki Israel na ka ri ba Nga la ai bynta ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki, lada ki sumar ban leh kat ïa kaba Nga la hukum ïa ki, ïa ka aiñ baroh, ïa ki aiñ synshar bad ïa ki riti aiñ ba la ai da u Moses.”
U Manasse u la ïalam bakla ïa ki Juda bad ïa kiba shong ha Jerusalem, kumta ki la leh sniew kham palat ban ïa kaba la leh ki jait bynriew kiba u Trai u la pynjot hakhmat ki paid Israel.
U Trai U la kren ha u Manasse bad ki briew jong u, hynrei kim patiaw satia.
Te kumta u Trai U la wan ïalam pyrshah ïa ki da ki rangbah jong ki pyrton u syiem Assiria. Kine ki la kem ïa u da ki bnoh bad ki la khum ïa u da ki kynjri rnong, nangta ki la ïalam ïa u sha Babilon.
Ynda u la ngat ha ka khim khait, u la kyrpad ïa ka jingisynei u Trai u Blei jong u bad u la pynrit ïa lade haduh katta katta hakhmat u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong u.
U la duwai ïa U, bad u Blei U la shah shkor ïa ka jingkyrpad jong u. U la wan ïalam biang ïa u sha Jerusalem, te hangta u Manasse u sa tip ba u Trai U long u Blei.

Hadien kane u la tei ïa ka kynroh kaba shabar na ka bynta ka Nongbah u Dabid kaba sha sepngi ka Gihon, ha them, bad u la pynpoi haduh ka khyrdop dohkha, nangta ter ter sawdong ka Ophel, bad u la pynjrong ïa ka shibun eh. U la buh ruh ki rangbah pyrton ha ki shnong kut baroh jong ka Juda.
Te u la weng noh ïa ki ’lei nongwei bad ïa ka blei thaw na ka ïing u Trai, nangta ïa ki duwan baroh kiba u la tei halor u lum jong ka ïing u Trai bad ha Jerusalem, bad u la bret ïa ki shabar shnong.
U la pynïeng biang ïa ka duwan u Trai, nangta u la tyrwa ki jynkñia jingsuk bad jingainguh, bad u la hukum ïa ki Juda ba ki dei ban shakri ïa u Trai u Blei ki Israel.
La katta ruh, ki briew ki dang kñia ha ki duwan halor lum, hynrei tang ha u Trai u Blei jong ki.

Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Manasse, ïa ka jingduwai jong u ha u Blei jong u, bad ïa ki ktien jong ki men kunok kiba la kren ha u ha ka kyrteng u Trai u Blei ki Israel, kine ki don ha ki Jynthoh kynmaw jong ki Syiem Israel.

Ïa ka jingduwai jong u, ïa ka jingkyrpad jong u bad kumno u Blei U la shah shkor ïa u, ïa ka pap bad ka jingbymkohnguh jong u, bad ïa ki jaka ha kiba u la tei ïa ki duwan halor lum bad u la pynïeng ïa ki Asherim bad ki dur blei, shuwa ba un pynrit ïa lade, ïa kine baroh la thoh ha ki Jynthoh kynmaw jong ki men kunok.
Te kumta u Manasse u la ïohthiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad ki la tep ïa u ha ka ïing jong u. U Amon u khun jong u u la mihbteng ïa u.
U Amon u la don arphew ar snem ka ryta haba u la sdang ban long syiem bad u la synshar ar snem ha Jerusalem.
U la leh sniew hakhmat u Trai, kumba la leh u Manasse u kpa jong u. U Amon u la kñia ha ki dur blei baroh kiba u kpa jong u u Manasse u la thaw bad u la shakri ïa ki.
Um shym pynrit ïa lade hakhmat u Trai, kumba la pynrit u kpa jong u u Manasse, kumta une u Amon u la kit pap shuh shuh.
Ki nongbud jong u ki la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u bad ki la pynïap ïa u ha ïing jong u hi.
Hynrei ki paidbah jong ka ri pat ki la pynïap ïa kito kiba la ïasylla pyrshah u syiem Amon. Ki paidbah jong ka ri nangta ki la thung syiem ïa u Josia u khun jong u, ban mihbteng ïa u.
U Josia u la don phra snem ka ryta haba u la sdang ban long syiem, bad u la synshar laiphew wei snem ha Jerusalem.
U la pynsngewbha ïa u Trai, bad u la ïaid ha ki lynti u Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u khlem da sakma sha kamon ne sha kadiang.

Te ha ka snem ka baphra jong ka jinglong syiem jong u, la u dang khynnah, u la sdang ban wad ïa u Blei jong u Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u, bad ha ka snem ka bakhat-ar u la sdang ban pynkhuid na Juda bad Jerusalem ïa ki duwan halor lum, ïa ki Asherim bad ki blei ba shu oh bad ba shu saiñ.

Ki la pyntwa ïa ki duwan jong ki Baal hakhmat jong u; u la shaiñ ïa ki duwan jyniwbih kiba halor jong ki; u la pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki Asherim lem bad ki dur blei ba shu oh bad ba shu saiñ, haduh ba kin da kylla khyndew, nangta u sa ber ïa ka halor ki jyntep jong kito kiba la kñia ha ki.
U la thang wat ïa ki shyieng jong ki lyngdoh halor ki duwan jong ki, bad kumta u la pynkhuid ïa ka Juda bad Jerusalem.
Ha ki shnong Manasse, Ephraim bad Simeon, bad ha ki shnong kiba sawdong jong ki haduh Naphtali,
u la pyntwa ïa ki duwan, u la pynlwet ïa ki Asherim bad ki dur blei haduh ba kin da ni hin, bad u la shaiñ pynpra ïa ki duwan jyniwbih ha ri Israel baroh kawei. Nangta u sa wan phai sha Jerusalem.

Te ha ka snem ka bakhatphra jong ka jingsynshar jong u, ynda u la pynkhuid ïa ka ri bad ka ïing, u la phah ïa u Shaphan u khun u Azalia, ïa u Maaseïa u lat ka nongbah, bad ïa u Joa u khun u Joahas, rangbah ïing syiem, ban maramot ïa ka ïing u Trai u Blei jong u.

Ki la wan sha u Hilkia u lyngdoh rangbah bad ki la ai ïa ka peisa ba la wan rah ha ka ïing u Blei, ïa kaba ki Lebi, kiba ap ïa ka tyngkong, ki la lum na ki Manasse bad ki Ephraim, na kiwei pat ki Israel baroh bad na ki Juda baroh bad ki Benjamin, bad na ki nong Jerusalem.
Ki la aiti ïa ka ha ki nongpynïaid kam kiba dei peit ïa ka ïing u Trai; kine pat ki la ai ïa ka ha ki nongtrei, na ka bynta ban maramot bad ban pynbha ïa ka ïing u Trai.
Ki la ai ïa ka ha ki misteri dieng bad ki nongtei ban thied maw shniah bad ki dieng ban pynlong khnong bad shankhung ïa ki ïing kiba ki syiem Juda ki la ieh noh sa haduh ba kin da sator.

Ki briew ki la trei hok. Ban long ki nongpeit halor jong ki, la buh ïa u Jahath bad u Obadia ki Lebi, napdeng ki khun u Merari, ïa u Zekharia bad u Meshullam, napdeng ki jait Kohath. Ki Lebi baroh kiba nang tem jyntem,
ki dei peit ïa ki nongkit jynkit bad ki pynïaid ïa ki briew baroh kiba trei kam naphang. La don kiwei pat ki Lebi kiba long nongthoh, rangbah pynïaid kam bad nongap khyrdop.
Katba ki dang ïasei ïa ka peisa ba wan rah ha ka ïing u Trai, u lyngdoh Hilkia u la shem ïa ka kitab jong ka aiñ u Trai ba la ai da u Moses.
Kumta u Hilkia u la ong ha u Shaphan, u nongthoh, “Nga la shem ïa ka kitab jong ka aiñ ha ka ïing u Trai.” Nangta u Hilkia u la ai ïa kata ka kitab ha u Shaphan.
U Shaphan u la leit rah ïa kata ka kitab sha u syiem, bad u la ong kumne ha u, “Ïa kiei kiei baroh ba la phah leh ha ki shakri jong phi, ki la leh.
Ki la shim lut ïa ka peisa kaba ki la shem ha ka ïing u Trai bad ki la ai ïa ka ha ka kti ki sordar bad ki nongtrei.”
U Shaphan nongthoh u la ïathuh ïa u syiem, “U lyngdoh Hilkia u la ai ha nga kawei ka kitab.” Te u Shaphan u la pule ïa ka hakhmat u syiem.
Te haba u syiem u la ïohsngew ïa ki ktien jong ka aiñ u la kad ïa la ki jaiñ.
U syiem u la hukum ïa u Hilkia, ïa u Ahikam u khun u Shaphan, ïa u Abdon u khun u Mika, ïa u Shaphan u nongthoh, bad ïa u Asaïa shakri syiem, u ong,

“Khie leit wad jingtip na u Trai na ka bynta jong nga bad na ka bynta kito kiba dang sah ha Israel bad ha Juda, shaphang ki ktien kiba ha ka kitab ba la shem. Naba ka jingbitar u Trai halor jong ngi ka long ka bakhraw, na ka daw ba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kim shym la rakhe ïa ka ktien u Trai, ban leh kumba la thoh ha kane ka kitab.”

Kumta u Hilkia bad ki briew kiba u syiem u la phah, ki la leit sha ka Hulda ka nongïathuhlypa, ka tnga u Shallum u khun u Tokhath, u khun u Hasra u nongsumar ïa ki jaiñ syiem; (kane ka shong mynta ha Jerusalem ha ka dong shnong ka ba-ar). Ki la kren ha ka shaphang kane ka kam,
ka pat ka la jubab, “U Trai u Blei ki Israel U ong kumne, ‘Ïathuh ha u briew uba phah ïa phi sha Nga:
U Trai U ong, Ngan sa pynwan ka jingjynjar halor kane ka jaka, bad ha ki trai shnong jong ka, baroh ki jingtim kiba la thoh ha kato ka kitab ba la pule hakhmat u syiem Juda.

Namarba ki la lyndet ïa Nga bad ki la thang jyniwbih ha kiwei pat ki blei, ki la pynkhie bitar ir ïa Nga da ki kam baroh ba ki la leh, te kumta ïa ka jingbitar jong Nga yn sa theh halor kane ka jaka bad yn ym pynlip ïa ka.
Hynrei khie leit ïathuh ha u syiem Juda uba la phah ïa phi ban wad jingtip na u Trai, u Trai u Blei ki Israel U ong kumne: Shaphang ki ktien ba phi la ïohsngew,

namarba ka dohnud ka jong phi ka la kylla ka bamut bad phi la pynrit ïa lade hakhmat u Blei tang shu ïohsngew ïa ki ktien jong U pyrshah kane ka jaka bad ki trai shnong jong ka, bad ba phi la pynrit ïa lade da kaba kad ïa la ki jaiñ bad da kaba ïam hakhmat jong Nga, te Nga la shah shkor ïa phi, u Trai U ong.

Ngan lum lang ïa phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi, bad yn sa lum lang ïa phi da ka jingsuk ha ka jyntep jong phi. Ki khmat jong phi kin ym ïohi ïa ka jingjynjar kaba Ngan sa pynwan halor kane ka jaka bad halor ki trai shnong jong ka.’ ” Hadien kata ki la wan rah khubor sha u syiem.
Te kumta u syiem u la khot lang ïa ki tymmen ki san baroh jong ka Juda bad ka Jerusalem.

Nangta u syiem u la leit kiew sha ïing u Trai, ryngkat bad ki paid Juda bad ki nong Jerusalem baroh, bad ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi, bad u paid baroh lin la khraw la rit. U la pule ba kin ïohsngew ïa ki ktien baroh jong ka jutang kiba don ha ka kitab ba la shem ha ka ïing u Trai.

Te u syiem u la ïeng na ka jaka jong u bad u la pynlong ka jutang bad u Trai, ban bud ïa u Trai bad ban rakhe ïa ki hukum jong U, ïa ki rai bad ki aiñ synshar jong U da ka dohnud bad ka mynsiem jong u baroh, bad ban pyndep ïa ki ktien jong ka jutang kumba la thoh ha kane ka kitab.
Nangta u la pynkubur ïa kita baroh kiba don ha Jerusalem bad Benjamin ban bat ïa ka. Ki nong Jerusalem ki la leh katkum ka jutang u Blei, u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki.

Te u Josia u la weng noh ïa ki jingijli baroh na ka ilaka baroh kawei jong ki paid Israel, bad u la pynlong ba ki Israel baroh kin shakri ïa u Trai u Blei jong ki. Katba u dang im kim shym kynriah shuh na kaba bud ïa u Trai u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki.
U Josia u la rakhe ïa ka paskha u Trai ha Jerusalem; bad ki la pynïap ïa u khun langbrot paskha ha ka sngi ka bakhatsaw jong u bnai u banyngkong.
U la thung ïa ki lyngdoh la ki kam ki kam bad u la pynshlur ïa ki ban pyndep ïa ki kam shakri ha ka ïing u Trai.

Ha ki Lebi pat kiba hikai ïa ki Israel baroh, bad kiba long ki bakhuid hakhmat u Trai, u la ong, “Buh ïa ka synduk bakhuid ha ka ïing ba u Solomon u khun u Dabid syiem Israel u la tei. Phim dei shuh ban bah ïa ka halor ki tyrpeng jong phi. Mynta to shakri ïa u Trai u Blei jong phi bad ïa ki paid jong U ki Israel.
Pynkhreh ïa lade shi kur shi kur ha la ka kynhun kynhun, da kaba bud ïa ki jingpynbeit u Dabid syiem Israel bad jong u Solomon u khun jong u.
To ïeng ha ka jaka bakhuid katkum ki kynhun ïingkur jong ki hynmen para jong phi, ki ’riewpaidbah. Ai ba yn don shi kynhun ki Lebi man shi ïingkur.
To pynïap ïa u khun langbrot paskha bad to pynkhuid ïa lade, bad to pynkhreh ruh ïa la ki hynmen para, ban leh kumba la ong u Trai da u Moses.”

Te u Josia u la ai na ka bynta ki paidbah laiphew hajar ki khun langbrot bad ki khun blang, bad sa ki masi kyrtong lai hajar, kum ki jyntyrwa paskha na ka bynta ki paidbah baroh kiba ïadon. Kine baroh ki long na ki spah ki hajar jong u syiem.

Ki rangbah syiem jong u da la ka mon sngewbha ki la ai na ka bynta ki paidbah, na ka bynta ki lyngdoh bad na ka bynta ki Lebi. U Hilkia, u Zekharia bad u Jehiel, ki rangbah duh ka ïing u Blei, ki la ai na ka bynta ki lyngdoh ki jyntyrwa paskha arhajar hynriewspah tylli ki khun langbrot bad ki khun blang, bad laispah tylli ki masi kyrtong.

U Konania ruh, lem bad u Shemaïa bad u Nethanel baroh shipara, nangta u Hashabia, u Jeïel bad u Jozabad, ki rangbah duh jong ki Lebi, ki la ai na ka bynta ki Lebi ki jyntyrwa paskha sanhajar tylli ki khun langbrot bad ki khun blang, lem bad ki masi kyrtong sanspah tylli.
Haba la lah pynkhreh, ïa ka jynleh niam, ki lyngdoh ki la ïeng ha la ki jaka, bad ki Lebi ha la ki kynhun kynhun katkum ka hukum u syiem.
Te ki la pynïap ïa u khun langbrot paskha, bad ki lyngdoh ki la synreit ïa ka snam kaba ki la pdiang na ki Lebi, katba ki Lebi pat ki nangkhoh snieh ïa ki mrad ba la pynïap.

Nangta ki la buh harud ïa ki jyntyrwa thang ban dup sam ïa ki katkum ki kynhun ïingkur jong ki paidbah, ban tyrwa ha u Trai, kumba la thoh ha ka kitab u Moses. Ki la leh ha kajuh ka rukom ïa ki masi kyrtong.

Ki la syang ïa u khun langbrot paskha da ka ding katkum ka riti aiñ; nangta ki la shet ïa ki jyntyrwa bakhuid ha ki khiew, ha ki karai, bad ha ki pliang, bad ki sa rah kloi kloi ïa ki sha ki paidbah baroh.

Hadien kata ki la pynkhreh sa ïa lade bad na ka bynta ki lyngdoh, namar ki lyngdoh ki khun u Aron ki la bunkam ha kaba tyrwa ïa ki jyntyrwa thang bad ki dkhot khleiñ haduh ynda miet. Te kumta ki Lebi ki la pynkhreh na ka bynta ïa lade bad na ka bynta ki lyngdoh ki khun u Aron.

Ki nongrwai, ki khun u Asaph, ki la don ha la ki jaka kumba la hukum u Dabid, u Asaph, u Heman bad u Jeduthun u men kunok syiem. Kiba ap khyrdop ki la don ha la ki khyrdop, kim dei ban khih na la ka kam, namar ki hynmen para jong ki, ki Lebi, ki la pyndep ïa ka Niam ka Rukom na ka bynta jong ki.
Kumta ïa ka jinglehniam ha u Trai la pynkhreh ha kata ka sngi, ban rakhe ïa ka Paskha bad ban tyrwa ki jyntyrwa thang halor ka duwan u Trai katkum ka hukum u syiem Josia.
Ki paidbah Israel kiba ïadon ki la rakhe ïa ka Paskha ha kata ka por, bad ïa ka jingkhawai niam jong u kpu khlem thiat hynñiew sngi.

Ym pat ju rakhe ka Paskha kaba kum kane ha Israel naduh ki sngi u Samuel nongïathuhlypa; ym pat ju don syiem Israel uba la rakhe ka Paskha kum ka Paskha u Josia, ki lyngdoh, ki Lebi bad ki paid Juda bad Israel, bad ki nong Jerusalem kiba la ïadon baroh.
La rakhe ïa kane ka Paskha ha ka snem ka bakhatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Josia.
Hadien katne ba u Josia u la pynryntih ïa ka tempyl, u Neko syiem Ijipt u la leit hiar thma ïa ka Karkhemish kaba ha Ïuphratis, bad u Josia u la leit ïaleh ïa u.

Utei u la phah ki nonglam ktien sha u, u ong, “Ngi don aïu ma ngi ban ïakajia, ko syiem Juda? Ngam shym wan pyrshah ïa phi mynta ka sngi, hynrei pyrshah ka ïing kaba nga ïadon thma; bad u Blei U la hukum ïa nga ban leh kyrkieh. Ieh wat leh pyrshah ïa u Blei, Uba don bad nga, ïoh U pynïap ei ïa phi.
La katta ruh u Josia um treh ban kynran, hynrei u la thaw buit pynban ban ïaleh thma ïa u. Um sngap satia ïa ki ktien u Neko kiba wan na ka shyntur u Blei. Kumta u la ïaleh thma ïa u ha them Megiddo.
Ki nongsiat khnam ki la siat ïa u syiem Josia, bad u syiem u la ong ha ki nongbud jong u, “Shim rah ïa nga, namar nga la mynsaw jur.”

Kumta ki nongbud jong u ki la sei ïa u na ka kali bad ki la pynkit ïa u ha kawei pat ka kali jong u, bad ki la leit rah ïa u shaduh Jerusalem. Te u la ïap, bad ki la tep ïa u ha ki jyntep jong ki kpa tymmen jong u. Baroh ki Juda bad ki nong Jerusalem ki la ïam briew na ka bynta u Josia.

U Jeremiïa ruh u la rwai sngewsih na ka bynta u Josia, bad ki nongrwai shynrang bad kynthei baroh ki dang kynmaw ïa u Josia ha ki jingrwai sngewsih jong ki haduh mynta mynne. Ki la pynlong ïa kine kum ka riti aiñ ha Israel, te kumta ki la thoh ha ki jingrwai bynñiaw.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Josia, ïa ki kam babha ba u la leh kat kumba la thoh ha ka aiñ u Trai,
bad ïa ki kam naduh basdang haduh bakut, la thoh ïa ki ha ka Kitab ki Syiem Israel bad Juda.
Ki paidbah jong ka ri ki la shim ïa u Jehoahas, khun u Josia, bad ki la thung syiem ïa u ban mihbteng ïa u kpa jong u ha Jerusalem.
U Jehoahas u la don arphew lai snem ka ryta haba u la sdang long syiem, bad u la synshar lai bnai ha Jerusalem.
Te u syiem Ijipt u la pynhiar khet ïa u ha Jerusalem bad u la shim khajna na ka ri shispah talen ka rupa bad shi talen ka ksiar.

Nangta u syiem Ijipt u la thung syiem ïa u para jong u u Eliakim halor ka Juda bad Jerusalem, bad u la pynkylla kyrteng ïa u, Jehoïakim. Hadien kata, u Neko u la kem ïa u hynmen jong u u Jehoahas, bad u la rah bak ïa u sha Ijipt.
U Jehoïakim u la don arphew san snem ka ryta haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar khatwei snem ha Jerusalem. U la pynsngewsih ïa u Trai u Blei jong u.
U Nebukhadnessar syiem Babilon u la wan ïaleh thma ïa u, u la teh ïa u da ki kynjri bad u la ring ïa u sha Babilon.
U Nebukhadnessar u la kit ruh shi bynta na ki khiew ki pliang jong ka ïing u Trai sha Babilon bad u la buh ïa ki ha ïing syiem jong u ha Babilon.

Te ïa kiwei pat ki kam jong u Jehoïakim, ïa ki kam ijli ba u la leh, bad ïa kiei kiei ba la shem pyrshah ïa u, la thoh ïa ki ha ka Kitab ki Syiem Israel bad Juda, bad u Jehoïakhin u khun jong u u la mih bteng ïa u.
U Jehoïakhin u la don khat-phra snem ka ryta haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la long syiem lai bnai bad shiphew sngi ha Jerusalem. U la leh ïa ka basniew hakhmat u Trai.

Ha ka pyrem jong kata ka snem, u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la phah wan ïalam ïa u sha Babilon, lem bad ki khiew ki pliang ki bakordor na ka ïing u Trai, bad u la thung syiem halor ka Juda bad Jerusalem ïa u hynmen jong u u Zedekia.
U Zedekia u la don arphew wei snem ka ryta haba u la sdang ban long syiem, bad u la synshar khatwei snem ha Jerusalem.
U la leh ïa ka basniew hakhmat u Trai u Blei jong u. Um shym pynrit ïa lade hakhmat u Jeremiïa nongïathuhlypa uba la kren da ka shyntur u Trai.
U la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ruh ïa u syiem Nebukhadnessar, uba la pynsmai ïa u da u Blei. U la leh mutlop bad u la pyn-eh ïa la ka dohnud ban ym phai shuh sha u Trai u Blei ki Israel.

Baroh ki lyngdoh ba kham rangbah bad ki paidbah ruh kumjuh ki la leh bymkohnguh shikatdei eh, da kaba bud ïa ki kam khlemraiñ jong kiwei pat ki jait bynriew. Ki la pynjyrsieh ïa ka Tempyl kaba u Trai U la pynkyntang ïa lade ha Jerusalem.
U Trai u Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki U la phah sha ki ter shi ter ki nongrah khubor, namarba U sngewsynei ïa la ki briew bad ïa ka jaka shong jong U.

Hynrei ki la beiñ sa beiñ ïa ki nongrah khubor jong u Blei, ki la isih ïa ki ktien jong ki bad ki la kynshi ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong U, haduh ba ka jingbitar u Trai ka la khie pyrshah ki paid jong U ba ym don lad shuh da kumwei.

Te kumta U la pynwan ïa u syiem Khaldi pyrshah ïa ki. Une u la pynïap ïa ki samla jong ki da ka waitlam ha ka jaka kyntang jong ka ïing; um shym sngewsynei ïa u samla ne ka theisotti, ïa uba la tymmen ne uba la ringswai. U la aiti ïa ki naphang ha ki kti jong u.
Ïa ki khiew ki pliang jong ka ïing u Blei, la khraw la rit, ïa ki jynkynshew ka ïing u Trai, bad ïa ki jynkynshew jong u syiem bad jong ki bakhraw batri, u la kit lut phoiñ sha Babilon.
Nangta ki la thang ïa ka ïing u Blei, ki la pyntwa ïa ka kynroh Jerusalem, ki la thang ïa ki ïingdulan jong ka baroh da ka ding, bad u la pynduh ïa ki khiew ki pliang kordor jong ka baroh.
U la ring koidi sha Babilon ïa kito baroh kiba lait na ka waitlam, bad ki la kylla ki mraw jong u bad jong ki khun jong u haduh ka jingsynshar ki Persha,
ban pyndep ïa ka ktien jong u Trai kumba la kren u Jeremiïa, “Ka ri kan sa ïoh ïa la ka jingshongthait sabath! Hynñiewphew snem lynter kan sa rakhe ïa la ki sabath ha ka jingsah kynjah!”

Te ha ka snem banyngkong jong u Sirus syiem Persha, ba yn dup pyndep ïa kaba u Trai U la kren da ka shyntur u Jeremiïa, u Trai U la pynkhih ïa u Sirus syiem Persha ban pynbna ha ka hima jong u baroh kawei, bad u la da thoh ruh artat

kumne: “U Trai u Blei ka bneng U la ai ha nga ïa ki hima baroh jong ka khyndew, bad U la hukum ïa nga ban tei kawei ka ïing na ka bynta jong U ha Jerusalem kaba ha Juda. Te man la u briew hapdeng jong phi uba dei u paid jong U, to un leit kiew, bad to u Trai u Blei jong u Un don ryngkat bad u.”
